sa: येऽन्यायेन जिहीर्षन्तो धनमिच्छन्ति कस्यचित्। तेभ्यस्तु न तदाख्येयं स धर्म इति निश्चयः॥
en: Sometimes men, desirous of getting hold of the wealth of some one, make enquiries. One should never answer such enquiries. That is settled duty.

sa: अद्य ज्ञास्यति भीमस्य बलं घोरं महात्मनः। हते दुर्योधने युद्धे शक्रेणेवासुरे बले॥
en: Today he will know the dreadful power of the great Bhima when Duryodhana will be slain in battle like the Asura Vali by Indra.

sa: देशकालप्रतीक्षी यो दस्यून् मर्षयते नृपः। शास्त्रजां बुद्धिमास्थाय युज्यत्ते नैनसा हि सः॥
en: That king who, knowing proper place and time and following the injunctions of the scriptures, pardons even a nuinber of robbers, incurs no sin.

sa: एषा विराट दुहिता स्नुषा गाण्डीवधन्वनः। आर्ता बालं पति वीरं दृष्ट्या शोचत्यनिन्दिता॥
en: There, the daughter of Virata, the daughterin-law of Arjuna, that girl of faultless beauty, stricken with grief on seeing her heroic husband, is bewailing.

sa: अवमन्यन्ति भर्तारं संघर्षादुपजीविनः। स्वे स्थाने न च तिष्ठन्ति लङ्घयन्ति च तद्वचः॥
en: If the master mixes too freely with them, servants begin to disregard him. They forget their own position and do not care their master.

sa: अद्य श्रुत्वा हतं पुत्रं धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। विह्वलः पतितो भूमौ किल्विषं प्रतिपद्यताम्॥
en: Today, hearing of his son's death, Dhritarashtra, that king of men, will lose consciousness, lie down on the Earth and feel the keenest pain.

sa: परिहासश्च भृत्यैस्ते नात्यर्थं वदतां वर। कर्तव्यो राजशार्दूल दोषमत्र हि मे शृणु॥
en: O foremost of speakers, you should never cut jokes with your servants. O foremost of kings, listen to the short-comings of such an act.

sa: रामं दाशरथिं चैव मृतं संजय शुश्रुम। योऽन्वकम्पत वै नित्यं प्रजाः पुत्रानिवौरसान्॥
en: We hear, O Srinjaya, that Rama also, the son of Dasharatha, met with death. He always treated his subjects like his own begotten sons.

sa: तमुवाचाथ गाङ्गेयो वृषभः सर्वधन्विनाम्। मां पृच्छ तात विश्रब्धं मा भैस्त्वं कुरुसत्तम॥
en: Then Ganga's son, that best of bowmen, addressed Yudhishthira, saying,—'Do not fear, O best of the Kurus. Ask me, O child, without any hesitation.'

sa: दण्डनीतिं पुरस्कृत्य विजानन् क्षत्रियः सदा। अनवाप्तं च लिप्सेत लब्धं च परिपालयेत्॥
en: Following the great science the learned Kshatriya should try to acquire those objects which he seeks and protect those which he has already acquired.

sa: दूरादेव तमालोक्य कृष्णो राजा च धर्मजः। चत्वारः पाण्डवाश्चैव ते च शारद्वतादयः॥ अवस्कन्द्याथ वाहेभ्यः संयम्य प्रचलं मनः। एकीकृत्येन्द्रियग्राममुपतस्थुर्महामुनीनन॥
en: Seeing him from a distance, Krishna and Dharma's royal son, the four Pandavas, and the others headed by Shwaradwat, got down from their cars and restraining their minds and concentrating all their senses, approached the great Rishis.

sa: ततो राज्ञः कलत्राणि भ्रातृणां चास्य सर्वतः। वाहनेषु समारोप्य अध्यक्षाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Then the guards of the ladies, placing the wives of the king, as also those of his brothers, on vehicles, fled away in fear.

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं तमेव रथिनां वरः॥
en: After the fall of that hero, the valiant son of Drona, that foremost of car-warriors, speedily got upon the car of his slain enemy.

sa: अदण्ड्या मे द्विजाश्चेति प्रतिजानीहि हे विभो। लोकं च संकरात्कृत्स्नं त्रासास्मीति परंतप॥
en: O powerful one, know that Brahmanas are exempt from punishment, and promise further that you would protect the world from an intermixture of castes.

sa: आवयोर्जीवतो राजन् मयि च त्वयि च ध्रुवम्॥ संशय:सर्वभूतानां विजये नौ भविष्यति।
en: If both of us, that is, yourself and myself, be alive, then all creatures will remain in doubt as to whom the victory belongs.

sa: प्राणिनो नाप्सु मज्जन्ति नान्यथा पावकोऽदहत्। रुजाभयं न तत्रासीद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: No death occurred by drowning or by fire. As long as Rama ruled it, there was no fear in his kingdom of any ailment.

sa: अगम्यागमनं चैव वाच्यावाच्यं तथैव च। भक्ष्याभक्ष्यं च राजेन्द्र दोषादोषं च नात्यजन्॥
en: Unrestrained sexual indulgence began. Men began to say what they liked. All distinctions between clean and unclean food and between virtue and vice disappeared.

sa: रथर्षभाणां सर्वेषां कथमासीत् तदा मनः। बालं त्वां परिवार्येकं मम दुःखाय जनुषाम्॥
en: What did those great car-warriors think at that time when they surrounded you, a warrior of tender years, and killed you to my grief?

sa: श्रुतायुषि हते वीरे जलसन्धे च पौरवे। श्रुतायुधे च नृपतौ नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After the fall of even the heroic Shrutayush, of also Jalasandha of Puru's race and of king Shrutayudha, the slaughter did not still cease.

sa: न राज्यलाभो विपुलः शत्रूणां च पराभवः। प्रीतिं धास्यति पार्थानां त्वामृते पुष्करेक्षण॥
en: Neither the acquisition of a vast territory, nor the discomfitures of their foes, gives joy to the Parthas bereft of you, O lotus-eyed one.

sa: एवं धर्मेण वृत्तेन प्रजास्त्वं परिपालय। स्वन्तं पुण्यं यशो नित्यं प्राप्स्यसे कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Behaving thus virtuously you should protect your subjects. You may then acquire, O delighter of the Kurus, fame that is eternal, high, and pure.

sa: सुषेणस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः पाण्डवस्य महद् धनुः॥ चिच्छेद प्रहसन् युद्धे क्षुरप्रेण महारथः।
en: Then worked up with wrath, the mighty car-warrior Sushena, cut off, in that battle, the formidable bow of Pandu's son with a razorshaped arrow.

sa: त्रयः शब्दा न जीर्यन्ते दिलीपस्य निवेशने। स्वाध्यायघोषो ज्याघोषो दीयतामिति वै त्रयः॥
en: Three sounds never ceased in Dwilipa's mansion, viz., the sound of Vedic recitations, the twang of bows, and cries of Let it be given.

sa: अहो भवत्या मन्त्रस्य गृहनेन वयं हताः॥ निधनेन हि कर्णस्य पीडितास्तु सबान्धवाः।
en: Alas, for your concealing this fact we have been undone! By the death of Karna, ourselves with all our friends have been greatly sorry.

sa: अहं वनं गमिष्यामि ह्यजिनैः प्रतिवासितः। रतिर्हि नास्ति मे राज्ये हतपक्षस्य भारत॥
en: Clad in deer-skins I would enter into woods. I have no desire for kingdom, shorn as I am of friends and allies, O Bharata.

sa: सुखं सांग्रामिको मृत्युः क्षत्रधर्मेण युध्यताम्॥ मृतो दुःखं न जानीते प्रेत्य चानन्तमश्नुते।
en: Happy is the death in the battle-field. Follow your Kshatriya duties and fight. The dead know no misery. They however enjoy eternal bliss hereafter.

sa: भवान् धर्मपरो यत्र बुद्धिश्रेष्ठश्च भारत। मुह्यते प्राणिनां ज्ञात्वा गतिं चागतिमेव च॥
en: You are virtuous and highly intelligent, O Bharata! You know also that which all creatures should do and that which they should not do.

sa: यः स्वयं प्रतिहन्ति स्म शासनं विषये रतः। स बाहुभ्यां विनिग्राह्यों लोकयात्राविघातकः॥
en: That man, who addicted to earthly objects, disregards wholesome restrictions, that man who transgresses at social harmony, should be punished with a strong hand.

sa: देवतेव हि सर्वार्थान् कुर्याद् राजा प्रसादितः। वैश्वानर इव क्रुद्धः समूलमपि निर्दहेत्॥
en: This, O king, was said by Yama. Its truth is seen in the wordly affairs. I shall now do what would increase your prosperity.

sa: अनुतिष्ठस्व तद् राजन् पितृपैतामहं पदम्। ब्राह्मणेषु तपो धर्मः स नित्यो वेदनिश्चितः॥
en: Do you, therefore, O king, follow your forefathers. The penances are the duty of the Brahmanas. This is the eternal prescription of the Vedas.

sa: एवं कोशस्य महतो ये नराः परिपन्थिनः। तानहत्वा न पश्यामि सिद्धिमत्र परंतप॥
en: So they who stand in the way of replenishing a treasury must be killed. I do not see how else success can be acquired.

sa: ते समन्तान् परिवृताः पाण्डवाः पुरुषर्षभाः॥ क्षोभयन्ति स्म तां सेनां मकरा: सागरं यथा। वृक्षानिव महावता: कम्पयन्ति स्म तावकान्॥
en: Having taken their positions round the king, the Pandavas, those foremost of men, began te) agitate the enemy's army like Makaras agitating the ocean. Indecd, they made your army tremble like a mighty tempest shaking the trees.

sa: कारयामास राज्यं च पितरि स्वर्गते नृपा वर्षाणां शतमेकं च सहस्रं भीमविक्रमः॥
en: Of great prowess, he ascended the throne of his father after the latter had died, and reigned for one thousand and one hundred years.

sa: त्रिवर्ग इति विख्यातो गण एष स्वयम्भुवा। चतुर्थो मोक्ष इत्येव पृथगर्थः पृथग्गुणः॥
en: The self-create named the book as one of three subjects. He treated of a fourth subject called liberation whose meaning and attributes are different.

sa: ततः प्रीतो महासेनस्त्रिदशेभ्यो वरं ददौ। रिपून् हन्तास्मि समरे ये वो वधचिकीर्घवः॥
en: Well pleased (with these attentions) Skanda granted a boon to all the celestials, saying-1 shall kill all your enemies, that wish to kill you.

sa: इह त्वं यज देवेन्द्र दद दानान्यनेकशः॥ अत्राप्लुत्य सुघोरात् त्वं पातकाद् विप्रमोक्ष्यसे।
en: There, O king of gods, perform a sacrifice. Distribute enough of presents. Performing thy ablutions there, you shall be freed off of your sin.'

sa: नैव तेऽस्ति परो लोको नापरः पापकर्मणः! धान् दारान् परित्यज्य यस्त्वमिच्छसि जीवितुम्॥
en: Sinful as you are, you will acquire neither this world nor the next, since you wish to live, having cast off your married wife?

sa: मुहूर्तमपि तं प्राज्ञः पण्डितं पर्युपास्य हि। क्षिप्रं धर्मान् विजानाति जिह्वा सूपरसानिव॥
en: By waiting upon a learned person for even a moment, the wiseman, however, succeeds in understanding his duties like the tongue tasting the soup.

sa: दृढाहतः पत्रिभिरुग्रवेगैः पार्थेन कर्णो विविधैः शिताः। बभौ गिरिगैरिकधातुरक्तः क्षरन् प्रपातैरिव रक्तमम्भः॥
en: Thus wounded by Partha with many keen and powerful arrows Karna looked like a red chalk mountain with streams of red water pouring down.

sa: ततो महोदरः क्रुद्धो राजानं वीक्ष्य धर्षितम्। त्यक्त्वा मृत्युभयं क्रुद्धो युद्धाकाङ्क्षी व्यलोकयत्।।
en: Then Mahodara, enraged on seeing the king sore pressed, casting off fear, and wrought up with rage, began to go around, eager for fight.

sa: ततः प्रजविताश्वेन रथेन स महारथः। द्वारेण निर्ययौ तेन यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।॥
en: That mighty car-warrior, went out in his chariot drawn by quick coursing steeds by that gate which led to where Rāma and Lakşmaņa were.

sa: स तु क्षिप्तो बलवता परिघस्तस्य रक्षसः। धनुश्च सशरं हस्ताच्छिरस्त्राणं च पातयत्॥
en: Being hurled by the highly powerful (Angada) the parigha, struck down from his hands the bow with arrows and the helmet of the Rākşasa.

sa: तच्चास्य बलमादास्ये बलेन महता वृतः। उदितः सविता काले नक्षत्राणां प्रभामिव ॥
en: As at the proper hour the risen Sun defeat the splendour of the stars, will I, surrounded by a mighty army, overpower his strength.

sa: ततो विदुद्रुवुः सर्वे तस्मात्रस्ता रणाजिरे। सुराश्च क्षुभिताः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा दण्डोद्यतं यमम्॥
en: In the field of battle, everyone afficted with fear, ran away from it. And beholding Yama with his rod uplifted, the celestials were agitated.

sa: वरः खलु मयैतस्मै दत्तस्त्रिदशपुङ्गव। स त्वया नानृतः कार्यो यन्मया व्याहृतं वचः॥
en: For, O foremost of celestials, I have conferred a boon on him; and you should not render false the words that I have uttered.

sa: सा मे न शय्यामारोदुमिच्छत्यलसगाभिनी। त्रिषु लोकेषु चान्या मे न सीतासदृशी तथा॥
en: That indolent damsel wish not to ascend my bed; nor is there any in the three spheres, that to me is like to Sītā.

sa: त्वं क्रुद्धस्त्विह कामात्मा गत्वा तस्याश्रमं मुनेः। दृष्टवांश्च तदा तां स्त्री दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव॥
en: But being enraged and possessed by lust you did repair to the hermitage of the ascetic and see her resplendent like the flaming fire.

sa: सा बभूव मुहूर्तेन हरिभिर्दीपिता पुरी। लोकस्यास्य क्षये घोरे प्रदीप्तेव वसुंधरा ॥
en: In a short time that city set on fire by the monkeys, looked like the earth glowing at the time of the Universal dissolution.

sa: इत्युक्ता राक्षसेन्द्रेण राक्षसास्ते महाबलाः। ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्॥ द्विषत्पक्षमविज्ञाय नीतिबाह्यास्त्वबुद्धयः।
en: Being thus accosted by their lord, the highly powerful Rākşasas, devoid of good sense and ignorant of sound counsel, replied with folded palms, saying.

sa: स तस्मिन्नचले तिष्ठन् वनान्युपवनानि च। स नगाग्रे स्थितां लङ्कां ददर्श पवनात्मजः॥
en: And stationing himself in that mountain, the offspring of the Wind-god beheld woods and groves and Lankā established at the brow of the mountain.

sa: स नाभ्यां पूजितः पूज्यः कपिभिश्च प्रसादितः। दृष्टा देवीति विक्रान्तः संक्षेपेण न्यवेदयत्॥
en: And honoured by the monkeys as he very well deserved to be, and gratified by them, (he) briefly said—“Seen have I the exalted lady."

sa: विक्रमेण समानेष्ये सीतां हत्वा यथा रिपुम्। रावणं पापकर्माणं तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: It behove you so to arrange things that, slaying the foe, Rāvana of impious acts, we may bring higher Sītā by our own prowess.

sa: युक्ता रामस्य भवती धर्मपत्नी गुणान्विता। प्रतिसंदिश मां देवि गमिष्ये यत्र राघवः॥
en: You are the worthy spouse of Răma, religiously wedded and crowned with many qualities. Permit me, O worshipful dame, to proceed where Rāghava is.

sa: सा विसृष्टभुजा भीमा पपात लवणाम्भसि। मया पर्वतसंकाशा निकृत्तहृदया सती ॥ शृणोमि खगताना च वाचः सौम्या महात्मनाम्। राक्षसी सिंहिका भीमा क्षिप्रं हनुमता हता॥
en: Thereat, throwing about her arms, that terrific one dropped into the salt waters. On that chaste one, resembling a hill, having her heart torn, I heard the meet speech of magnanimous persons, who had come there of themselves, 'This dreadful Rākşasi, Sinhikā, has been swiftly slain by Hanumān.

sa: तासु चैव प्रसुप्तासु सीता भर्तृहिते रता। विलप्य करुणं दीना प्रशुशोच सुदुःखिता॥
en: And on their sleeping, Sītā intent on the welfare of her lord, lamenting piteously, in forlorn guise, and stricken with extreme sorrow, mourned profusely.

sa: इयं कनकवर्णाङ्गी रामस्य महिषी प्रिया। प्रणष्टापि सती यस्य मनसो न प्रणश्यति॥
en: This one having a golden countenance must be the beloved queen of Rāma who, albeit separated from him, has not disappeared from his mind.

sa: एवं वक्ष्यति को राजन् प्रभुः सन् वानरर्षभ। ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तो हि सर्वोऽहमिति मन्यते॥
en: O king, O foremost of monkeys, who else can speak thus being a master? Any one else, we think, is proud of his wealth.

sa: सर्वे यथा मां वक्ष्यन्ति समेत्य हरिपुङ्गवाः। तथास्मि कर्ता कर्तव्ये भवद्भिः परवानहम्॥
en: O leading monkeys, I shall follow what you will in a band desire me to do. In action I am subordinate to you all.

sa: राजन् वनमिदं दुर्गं तव भग्नं दुरात्मना। वानरेण ह्यविज्ञाय तव वीर्यं महाबल॥
en: O king, O you of mighty prowess, this your forest and castle has been broken down by the vicious-souled monkey not knowing your strength.

sa: गेयात्पुष्पसमृद्ध्या च शैत्याद्वायोगिरेर्गुणात्। प्रवृत्तायां रजन्यां च चन्द्रस्योदयनेन च॥ रावणः स महावीर्यः कामस्य वशमागतः। विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य शशिनं समवैक्षत॥
en: Being possessed by desire through songs, richness of flowers, coldness of air, beauty of the hills, and the rising of the moon is night, the highly powerful Rāvana espied again and again the moon with heavy sighs.

sa: अन्येभ्योऽपि त्वया रक्ष्या प्राप्नुयां धर्षणं यदि। तद्धर्मतः स्नुषा तेऽहं तत्त्वमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Rather should you protect me if any body else try to oppress me. Virtually I am your daughterin-law. I speak to you the truth.

sa: विश्रम त्वं पृथुश्रोणि शिलातलमिदं शुभम्। त्रैलोक्य यः प्रभुश्चैव मदन्यो नैव विद्यते॥
en: Do you take rest upon this excellent rock, O you having charming waist. There is no other lord, save me, in the three worlds.

sa: तस्मै दृढतरं क्रुद्धो जघान गदया हयान्। विभीषणो महातेजा रावणेः स दुरात्मनः॥
en: Thereat, enraged at him more furiously then ever, the exceedingly energetic Vibhīşana with his mace despatched the steeds of the wickedminded son of Răvaņa.

sa: सा तं हरिवरं दृष्ट्वा लङ्का रावणपालिता। स्वयमेवोत्थिता तत्र विकृताननदर्शना ॥ पुरस्तात् तस्य वीरस्य वायुसूनोरतिष्ठत। मुञ्चमाना महानादमब्रवीत् पवनात्मजम्॥
en: Seeing that best of monkeys, Lankā, ruled by Rāvana arising of herself with her countenance rendered deformed, stood before the heroic son of the Wind and, emitting a tremendous roar, addressed the offspring of the Wind-god, saying,

sa: साधु सौम्या निवर्तध्वं किं प्राणान्परिरक्षथ। नालं युद्धाय वै रक्षो महतीयं विभीषिका॥
en: You amiable ones, desist. Why should you save yourselves? This Rākşasa does not come to fight, this is only a great phenomenon to affright.

sa: संशयस्थमिदं सर्व शत्रोः प्रतिसमासने। एकस्य गमनं तात नहि मे रोचते भृशम्॥
en: On approaching the foe, this whole host itself shall be imperilled: and therefore, my child, your marching alone does nowise recommend itself to me.

sa: प्रवृद्धः काञ्चनो वृक्षः फलकाले निकृन्त्यते। न नप्तारं स्वकं न्याय्यं शप्तुमेवं प्रजापते॥
en: You hew down a golden tree when about to bear fruit. O lord of creatures, you ought not to curse thus your own grandson.

sa: सहसा स तदोत्पत्य राक्षसस्य महहावे। मुष्टिं संवर्त्य वेगेन पातयामास वक्षसि ॥
en: Rising up all on a sudden he, clenching his fist, struck that Rakşsas in the mighty encounter on his braeast and got him down.

sa: तां प्रतिज्ञा प्रतिज्ञाय पुरा सत्यपराक्रम। लघुः कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो नैवं त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Having bound yourself by that vow, it does not, O you having truth for prowess, behove you to speak like one fickle and feeble.

sa: न त्वां शक्तः परित्रातुमपि साक्षात् पुरंदरः। कुरुष्व हितवादिन्या वचनं मम मैथिलि।॥
en: And even, Purandara's (Another name of Indra-the lord of the celestials.) self cannot save yoll. Do you therefore hear, O Maithili, my well-mcaning words.

sa: नीलः शरैरभिहतो निशितैर्व्वलनोपमैः॥ स तं परमदुर्धर्षमापतन्तं महाकपिः। प्रहस्तं ताडयामास वृक्षमुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: That mighty monkey-Nila-endowed with energy, struck with those sharpened shafts resembling flames, uprooting a tree, assailed therewith the irrepressible Prahasta-who was rushing against him.

sa: ततोऽन्यं पातयत्क्रोधाच्छङ्खदेशे महातलम् । महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन तलेनाभिहतः क्षितौ ॥ पपात रुधिरक्लिन्नः शोणितं हि समुगिरन्। स्रोतोभ्यस्तु विरूपाक्षो जलं प्रस्रवणादिव॥
en: Immediately in anger he struck him down with a blow on his forehead. And being thus assailed with the fist resembling the thunder-bolt of Mahendra, he fell down on the earth bathed in a pool of blood.

sa: सा राक्षसीमध्यगता सीता सुरसुतोपमा। न शर्म लेभे शोकार्ता रावणेनेव भर्त्तिता ॥
en: And being surrounded by the Rākṣasīs and threatened by Rāvana, Sītă, resembling the daughter of a celestial, stricken with grief, could not console herself.

sa: आत्मनः सदृशं वीरं स तं निक्षिप्य वानरम्। सुग्रीवोऽभिमुखं शत्रु प्रतस्थे पादपायुधः॥
en: Placing that heroic monkey, his equal in prowess, in that command Sugrīva sallied out with a tree in his hand to meet the enemy.

sa: सर्वथा तेन हीनाया रामेण विदितात्मना। तीक्ष्णं विषमिवास्वाद्य दुर्लभं मम जीवनम् ॥
en: And separated from Rāma of subdued soul, it is as difficult for me to breathe as for him who has drank up virulent poison.

sa: अहं तु नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम। निर्जिताहं त्वया वीर विक्रमेण महाबल॥
en: By your prowess, O Monkey, had you, O hero, O you gifted with wondrous strength, vanquished me myself, who am the City of Lankā.

sa: धन्याः खलु महात्मानो मुनयः सत्यसम्मताः। जितात्मानौ महाभागा येषां न स्तः प्रियाप्रिये।४७।।
en: Oh blessed are those high-souled, great ascetics abiding by truth and having their senses in control, who have no objects of love or displeasure.

sa: पक्षी च शाखानिलयं प्रविष्टः पुनः पुनश्चोत्तमसान्त्ववादी। सुखागतां वाचमुदीरयाणः पुनः पुनश्चोदयतीव हृष्टः॥
en: And the birds, again and again, entering their nests, and highly delighted are pouring forth their notes announcing the advent of a happy occasion.

sa: हा राम हा लक्ष्मण हा सुमित्रे हा राममातः सह मे जनन्यः। मृगरूपधारी एषा विपद्याम्यहमल्पभाग्या महार्णवे नौरिव मूढवाता॥
en: O Rama! O Laksmana! O Sumitra! O Rama's mother! O my mothers! I am worsted in this ocean of grief, like to a bark, driven hither and thither by the blast, in the midst of an ocean.

sa: ततो मां सम्परिक्षिप्य सर्वतो विकृताननाः। वधे च ग्रहणे चैव कुर्युर्यत्नं महाबलाः॥
en: And thereupon casting their looks all around and finding me out, those highly powerful and grim-viasged demons shall try to kill or catch ine.

sa: पूर्वं तु द्वारमासाद्य नीलो हरिचमूपतिः॥ अतिष्ठत्सह मैन्देन द्विविदेन च वीर्यवान् ।
en: And coming to the Eastern gate, that leader of the monkeys-army, the powerful Nila, along with Mainda and Dvivida, took up his post there.

sa: अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलमनिर्वेदः परं सुखम्। भूयस्तत्र विचेष्यामि न यत्र विचयः कृतः॥
en: But perseverance is the source of good fortune; and perseverance bring about supreme happiness. Search again I will, where I have not yet searched.

sa: आत्मानं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम्। सोऽहं यश्च यतश्चाहं भगवांस्तद् ब्रवीतु मे॥
en: I know myself to be man-Rama, the son of Dasaratha. Let the great Patriarch tell me, who I am and whence I have come.

sa: आगतस्य हि रामस्य क्षिप्रमङ्कागतां सतीम्। अहं द्रक्ष्यामि सिद्धार्थां त्वां शत्रौ विनिपातिते।।२९
en: On the enemy having fallen, I shall behold you, devoted to your lord, with your desire attained, soon lying on the lap of Rama.

sa: न त्वेवं वानरा हन्तुं शक्याः पादपयोधिनः। सुरा देवर्षभेणेव रामेण हि सुरक्षिताः॥
en: The monkeys fighting with trees, well protected by Rāghava, like the gods protected by the foremost of the celestials, are incapable of being slain.

sa: अद्य वैवस्वतो राजा भूयो बहुमतो मम॥ येनाद्य त्वं महाबाहो संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा।
en: Today king Vivasvata has raised himself immensely in my estimation, for today he, O mighty-armed one, has brought you under the law of Time.

sa: किमिदं वर्तसे भद्रे विरुद्धं यौवनस्य ते। नहि युक्ता तवैतस्य रूपस्यैव प्रतिक्रिया।४॥
en: How is it, o amiable one, that you act thus contrary to your youth? This course of life surely does not befit your beauty.

sa: तस्याहं कुर्वतो नित्यं वेदाभ्यासं महात्मनः। संभूता वाङ्गायी कन्या नाम्ना वेदवती स्मृता॥
en: And while that high sound one was engaged in the daily study of the Vedas, I was born as his word-impregnated daughter, named Vedavati.

sa: कामं त्वमपि पर्याप्तो निहन्तुं सर्वराक्षसान्। राघवस्य यशो हीयेत् त्वया शस्तैस्तु राक्षसैः॥
en: You are capable of destroying the Rākṣasas very easily (I admit)—but Rama's fame shall then be souled if do you bring about their destruction.

sa: न मे तूणीशयान्बाणान्सविषानिव पन्नगान्। रामः पश्यति संग्रामे तेन मां योद्भुमिच्छति ॥
en: Rāma has not seen my shafts resting in the quiver, resembling venomous serpents, and therefore it is that he seek to fight with me.

sa: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सर्वैश्च परमर्षिभिः। त्रील्लोकान् सम्परिक्रम्य तमेव शरणं गतः॥
en: And being then renounced by his father (Indra) and the great ascetics, he, ranging the three worlds, at last resorted to his (Rāma's) shelter.

sa: ये च मद्विषयस्था वै मानवाः क्षुधयार्दिताः। त्वयि भुक्ते सुतृप्तास्ते भविष्यन्ति सबान्धवाः॥
en: Those men residing in my dominion, being smitten with hunger, shall be refreshed along with your relations, when you have eaten and been refreshed.

sa: न वृथा ते श्रमोऽयं स्यात्संशये न्यस्य जीवितम्। सुहृज्जनपरिक्लेशो न चायं विफलस्तव॥
en: You would not have been required to undergo this toil at the risk of your own life and giving unnecessary trouble to your friends.

sa: अथापगेयं भीष्मं त्वं रामेणेच्छसि धीमता। रणे विनिर्जितं द्रष्टुं कुर्यात् तदपि भार्गवः॥
en: Or if you desire to see the blamable Bhishma vanquished in battle by the wise Rama, he, of Bhrigu's family, will do that too.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो युयुत्सुः कौरव्यान् परित्यज्यसुतांस्तव। जगाम पाण्डुपुत्राणां सेनां विश्राव्य दुन्दुभिम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then abandoning the Kurus, your son, Yuyutsu, went over to the army of the Pandavas with the best of drums and cymbals.

sa: शृणु भूयो यथातत्त्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। कारणं भरतश्रेष्ठ पाण्डवानां जयं प्रति॥
en: Hear again the true reason, about which you had asked me, for the victory of the sons of Pandu, O foremost of the Bharatas.

sa: स वारणरथौघानां सहस्रैर्बहुभिर्वृतः। वाजिभिः पत्तिभिश्चैव वृतः शतसहस्रशः॥ धनुर्विस्फार्य संक्रुद्धो नोदयित्वा च वाहिनीम्। ययौ तं मद्रकानीकं केकयांश्च परंतप॥
en: Followed by many thousands of horsemen and foot soldiers and many hundreds of elephants and cars and the Madras and the Kaikayas, with his bow drawn in wrath and with all his troops behind him he advanced.

sa: अर्जुनस्तु रणे नादं विनद्य रथिनां वरः। त्रिगर्तराजं समरे सपुत्रं विव्यधे शरैः॥
en: Thereupon Arjuna, that foremost of carwarriors, uttering his war-cry in battle pierced the ruler of the Trigaretas and his son with myriad's of shafts.

sa: यदुपायात सायाह्ने कृत्वा पार्थस्य किल्बषम्। अभिमन्यौ हते तात कथमासीन्मनो हि वः॥
en: After that wrong had been inflicted on Arjuna in the evening. What was the state of your mind, O son, when Abhimanyu was slain?

sa: देशानां च परीमाणं नगराणां च संजय। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन यत एते समागताः॥
en: O Sanjaya, I desire to hear in great detail about the situations and dimensions of those countries and cities from which they have come.

sa: एष द्रोणः कृपः शल्यो विकर्णश्च जनार्दन। धार्तराष्ट्राश्च सहिता दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः॥ पञ्चालान् निहनिष्यन्ति रक्षिता दृढधन्वना। सोऽहं भीष्मं वधिष्यामि सैन्यहेतोर्जनार्दन॥
en: O Janardana, Drona, Kripa, Shalya, Vikarna with the sons of Dhritarashtra headed by Duryodhana and protected by this great bowman (Bhishma) will destroy the Panchalas. OJanardana, I shall, therefore, kill Bhishma for the good of my troops.

sa: अन्योन्यस्पर्धिनां होषां यद्येकं यं करिष्यसि। शेषा विमनसो व्यक्तं न योत्स्यन्ति हितास्तव॥
en: If you promote among several contending rivals, the rest, it is clear, being depressed, will not fight with a desire for doing your good.

sa: बाह्यं मृत्यु भयं कृत्वा तावकान् पाण्डवा ययुः। सादिनः सादिनोऽभ्यघ्नंस्तथैव रथिनो रथान्॥
en: Then your troops, disregarding their kingdoms and the fear of death, encountered those of the Pandavas. Horse soldiers slew horse-soldiers and car-warriors slew warriors.

sa: स क्षिप्रं वधमन्विच्छन्नात्मनोऽभिमुखो रणे। न हन्यां मानवश्रेष्ठान् संग्रामे सुबहूनिति॥ चिन्तयित्वा महाबाहुः पिता देवव्रतस्तव। अभ्याशस्थं महाराज पाण्डवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then wishing his quick slaughter at the face of the armies, and thinking, 'I will no longer slay foremost of car-warriors in battle,' your mighty-armed father Devavrata, addressing Yudhishthira who was then near him said these words.

sa: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्। कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च॥
en: Such men placing their minds on Me, devoting their lives to Me, instructing each other and speaking about Me, are always contended and happy.

sa: प्रयुद्धानां प्रभग्नानां पुनरावर्तिनामपि। नात्र स्वेषां परेषां वा विशेषः समदृश्यत॥ तस्मिंस्तु तुमुले युद्धे वर्तमाने महाभये। अतिसर्वाण्यनीकानि पिता तेऽभिव्यरोचत।॥
en: While fighting, or retreating, or rallying again, neither the men of our side nor those of the enemy's could be distinguished. But your father (Bhishma) shone transcending all that countless host in that fearful and terrible battle.

sa: संजय उवाच शिखण्डी सह मत्स्येन विराटेन विशाम्पते। भीष्ममाशु महेष्वासमाससाद सुदुर्जयम्॥ द्रोणं कृपं विकर्णं च महेष्वासं महाबलम्। राज्ञश्चान्यान् रणे शूरान् बहूना द् धनंजयः॥
en: Sanjaya said O ruler of men, Shikhandin, with the king of the Matsyas viz., Virata, speedily rushed against Bhishma, that mighty bowman difficult of being defeated in battle. Dhananjaya in that battle rushed against Drona, Kripa, Vikarna, and many kings, all mighty-bowmen, brave,, and endued with great prowess.

sa: राधेयस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राजा दुर्योधनस्ततः। भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजन् प्रायाद् द्रोणरथं प्रति॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, hearing the words of the son of Radha, king Duryodhana, with his brothers rushed where the car of Drona was.

sa: न भीमं समरे मेने मानुषं भरतर्षभ। ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्नर्दित्वा विपुलं स्वनम्॥
en: O best of men, they no longer considered Bhima as a human being. O king of kings, then setting up a loud shout, Bhima.

sa: एष चेदिपतिः शूरः सह पुत्रेण भारत। महारथानां सुकरं महत् कर्म करिष्यति॥
en: This hero, the king of the Chedis, along with his son, O Bharata, will do great deeds which can be done by Maharathas alone.

sa: अप्रियाणां च वचनं प्रब्रुवत्सु पुनः पुनः। अमर्ष दर्शयस्व त्वममर्षो ह्येव पौरुषम्॥
en: Show your wrath to them who on the eve of your excite again and again used harsh words to you, for wrath is manliness.

sa: स त्वं परेषां वीर्येण मन्यसे वीर्यमात्मनः। स्वयं कापुरुषो मूढ परांश्च क्षेप्तुमिच्छसि॥
en: You too think the prowess of others to be your own prowess; being yourself a coward, O fool, you want to have others slain.

sa: ततः श्रुतायुः संक्रुद्धो राज्ञा केतुमता सह। आससाद रणे भीमं व्यूढानीकेषु चेदिषु॥
en: Inflamed in anger, Shrutayu, clad in armour, followed by his troops in battle array and accompanied by king Ketumat, came in front of Bhima.

sa: अभिमन्यो वरं तात याचतां दातुमर्हसि। पितॄणां मातुलानां च सैन्यानां चैव सर्वशः॥
en: It behoves you, so O son, O Abhimanyu, to accord the boon that your sires, your uncles and all these soldiers beg of you.

sa: शिखण्डी तु भृशं राजस्ताङ्यमानः शितैः शरैः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं माधवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Thus wounded sore with sharp arrows, Shikhandin quickly ascended, O monarch, the car of the high-souled Satyaki, that scion of the dynasty of Madhu.

sa: स तथा कुरु गाङ्गेय यथा हन्येत फाल्गुनः। एवमुक्तस्ततो राजन् पिता देवव्रतस्तव।॥
en: O son of Ganga, therefore do that by which this Phalguna (Arjuna) might be killed”. O king, having been thus addressed, your father Devavrata.

sa: भविता त्वेतदेवं हि नैतज्जात्वन्यथा भवेत्। भव त्वनिन्दिता लोके कुरुष्व वचनं मम॥
en: This must have happened and nothing could have prevented it. Carry out my command; none in the world will find any fault with you.

sa: ततः शब्दो महानासीत् सैन्यानां तव भारत। अगाधं प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा समुद्रमिव कौरवम्॥
en: Thereupon O Bharata, a loud uproar was created by your troops as they beheld the illustrious Kuru king advance like the fathomless deep itself.

sa: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्। प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्॥
en: I am the goal, the supporter, the lord, the on-looker, the asylum, the friend, the source, the support, the receptacle and the imperishable। seed.

sa: युवानं निहतं वीरं लम्बमानं सकार्मुकम्॥ उदीर्णाश्च हया राजन् वहन्तस्तत्र तत्र ह।
en: O king, impetuous horses carried here and there the youthful riders killed and hung from their saddle with their bows till in their hands.

sa: रथात् प्रपतितं चैनं दिवियो भावः समाविशत्॥ अभ्यवर्षच्च पर्जन्यः प्राकम्पत च मेदिनी।
en: Being overthrown from his car, a divine inspiration took possession of him. The raincloud Parjanya then poured down its contents and the earth waked.

sa: ततः कबन्धं किंचित् तु धनुरालम्ब्य तिष्ठति। किंचित् खङ्गं विनिष्कृष्य भुजेनोद्यम्य तिष्ठति॥
en: Some headless tiunk were seen standing there, with their bows in grasp. Some again stood, with their drawn swords raised on air (for striking).

sa: अहत्वा समरे भीष्मं यदि यास्यसि महारिष अवहास्योऽस्य लोकस्टः भविष्यसि मया सह॥
en: If, O sire, you do return without slaying Bhishma in battle, you along with myself, shail be exposed to the derision of the world.

sa: यः स शक्र इवाक्षोभ्यो वर्षन् बाणान् सहस्रशः। जघान युधि योधानामर्बुदं दशभिर्दिनैः॥
en: Scattering thousands of arrows with the greatest composure, he who like Indra, daily killed ten thousand warriors and that too (continually) for ten days.

sa: तस्य तन्मतमाज्ञाय पाण्डवः सत्यदर्शनः। भीष्मं प्रति ययौ राजा संग्रामे सह संजयैः॥
en: Ascertaining that to be the desire of Bhishma, king Yudhishthira of unerring sight rushed against Bhishma in battle with the Srinjayas for his supporters.

sa: स तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा हृदयं चामितौजसः॥ जगाम धरणी बाणो महाशनिरिव ज्वलन्।
en: That arrow, as effulgent as the fire went through his armour and struck into the earth with a flash like that of the thunder-bolt.

sa: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च। सूक्ष्मत्वात् तद् विज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्॥
en: Who is within and without all creatures, immobile and mobile, who is not knowable, on account of his subtiety, who is remote yet near;

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अभिद्रवध्वं युध्यध्वं भीष्मं जयत संयुगे। रक्षिताः सत्यसंधेन जिष्णुना रिपुजिष्णुना॥
en: Yudhishthira said Proceed, fight! conquer Bhishma in battle; you will be protected by Jishnu of unerring aim who is ever the conqueror of foes;

sa: इयं हि मां सहा देवी भारार्ता समचूचुदत्। संहारार्थे महादेव भारेणाभिहता सती॥
en: The goddess of earth, over-burdened with the heavy weight of creatures, always solicited me for destroying the beings on her surface, O mighty God.

sa: यथा भीष्मः शान्तनवो मासेनेति मतिर्मम। एषा मे परमा शक्तिरेतन्मे परमं बलम्॥
en: Just like Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, by a month's time; so I think. This is my utmost power, this is my greatest strength.

sa: आत्मनैव कृतं कर्म आत्मनैवोपभुज्यते। इह च प्रेत्य वा राजंस्त्वया प्राप्तं यथातथम्॥
en: One reaps the fruits of actions done by himself; so, O monarch, do you reap here and hereinafter the fruits of your won actions.

sa: एवं तयोः संवदतोः फाल्गुनो निशितैः शरैः॥ शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य भीष्मं विव्याध संयुगे।
en: Thus when they were conversing with one another, Arjuna, placing Shikhandin before him, began to pierce Bhishma in battle with shafts of great sharpness.

sa: ततोऽभ्रान्ते रथे तिष्ठन् रामः प्रहरतां वरः। ववर्ष शरजालानि मयि मेघ इवाचले॥
en: That foremost of smiters, Rama then seated on a quick-going car, showered nets of arrows on me that fell like clouds on a mountain.

sa: स हि संदृश्य सेनां ते युयुधानेन पातिताम्। अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धः कुरूणां कीर्तिवर्धनः॥
en: Bhurishravas that enhancer of the glory of the Kurus, seeing that division of his troops felled by Yuyudhana (Satyaki) waiting wroth rushed against Satyaki.

sa: अक्षौहिण्या समं तत्र वामपक्षोऽभवत् तदा। महात्मा द्रुपदः श्रीमान् सह पुत्रेण संयुगे।॥
en: The high-souled Drupada ever attended with prosperity, along with his son, and supported by a Akshauhini of troops, formed its left wing. were son

sa: अथार्जुनाय प्रजिघाय भल्लान् भूरिश्रवाः सप्त सुवर्णपुडान्। दुर्योधनस्तोमरमुग्रवेगं शल्यो गदां शान्तनवश्च शक्तिम्॥
en: Bhurishrava hurled at Arjuna seven javelins with wings of gold, Duryodhana hurled a fearful lance, Shalva a mace and Shantanu's son (Bhishma) a dart.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो भूरिश्रवा राजन् सात्यकिं नवभिः शरैः। प्राविध्यद् भृशसंक्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O monarch, inflamed with wrath he pierced Satyaki with nine arrows, like an elephant-driver piercing the animal with the iron hook.

sa: केनावध्या महात्मानः पाण्डुपुत्रा महाबलाः। केन दत्तवरास्तात किं वा ज्ञानं विदन्ति ते॥
en: What asceticism those high-souled and greatly powerful sons of Pandu have observed, what boon, O child, have they secured, what knowledge have they cultivated,

sa: चमू द्रावयते क्रोधात् वृत्रो देवचमूमिव। तस्य चान्यन्न पश्यामि संयुगे भेषजं महत्॥
en: Is tossing in rage my army like Vritra tossing the celestial host. I do not see any other efficacious medicine for him in battle,

sa: तथा दृष्ट्वा च तत्सैन्यं जहषे तावकं बलम्। दृष्ट्वाऽऽचार्यं सुसंक्रुद्धं पतन्तं रिपुवाहिनीम्। चुक्रुशुः सर्वतो योधाः साधु साध्विति भारत॥
en: Beholding the hostile troops in that plight, your warriors were filled with delight and also beholding the aged preceptor consume the hostile array on all sides, O Bharata, the warriors sent up loud exclamations of “welldone" "well-done".

sa: तस्य पापस्य सततं क्रियमाणस्य कर्मणः। साम्प्रतं सुमहद् घोरं फलं प्राप्तं जनेश्वर॥
en: Let your sons now reap the fruit that resembles the poisonous fruit of the Kimpaka tree, of that their persistent course of sinful actions.

sa: अप्सु वर्षसहस्राणि सप्त चैकं च साऽनयत्। धारयित्वा तु नियमं नन्दायां वीतकल्मषा॥
en: She passed in those waters eight thousand years. Practising austere penances on the banks of the Nanda, she purged herself of all her sins.

sa: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि। न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही॥
en: As a man, casting off worn-out clothes, put on other new ones, so embodied. Self, casting off old bodies, enter into other new ones.

sa: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते। तत् स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति॥
en: There is nothing in this world which so much purifies (man) as knowledge. The man, perfected by Yoga, learns it within himself in time.

sa: अमङ्गल्यध्वज दृष्ट्वा न युध्येयं कदाचन' य एप द्रौपदो राजंस्तव सैन्ये महारथः॥
en: Hear also, O foremost of kings, about the vow that I had formerly taken. Beholding any inauspicious sign I would under no circumstance fight.

sa: स षष्ट्या सात्यकिं विद्धा स्वर्णपु? शिलाशितैः। ननाद बलवन्नादं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having pierced Satyaki with sixty shafts, all sharpened on stone and adorned with the feathers of gold, he roared most loudly and said-wait, wait.

sa: तद् यथा प्रेक्षमाणानां सूतपुत्रं महारथम्। न हन्यात् पाण्डव: संख्ये तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥
en: Adopt such measures that the son of Pandu may not kill that mighty car-warrior, i.e., the charioteer's son in battle in our very sight."

sa: यत्त्वत्र विहितं कार्ये नैष तद् वेत्ति माधव। स्त्रीवदेष बिभ]तां युक्तां कवचधारणाम्॥
en: But he knows not what is to be done with this armour, O Madhava, but wears this coat of mail even like a woman.

sa: ते तु दृष्ट्वा शिरो राजन् भारद्वाजस्य तावकाः। पलायनकृतोत्साहा दुद्रुवुः सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: Then the troops beholding that head of Bharadvaja's son, felt inclined to fly and O king, without much hesitation they took to their heels.

sa: दुर्योधनश्च विरथः कृतस्तत्र महारथः। धर्मपुत्रः कथं चक्रे तस्य वा नृपतिः कथम्॥
en: In that fair battle, Duryodhana was deprived of his car. How did the son of Dharma fight; and how also did that prince (Duryodhana)?

sa: सहदेवस्तौ राजन् नाराचेन तवात्मजम्। विद्ध्वा विव्याध सप्तत्या सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरै॥
en: Then, O monarch, Shahadeva, after having first pierced your son, again struck him with seventy shafts, as well as his charioteer with threc others.

sa: कोऽन्यः स्थास्यति संग्रामे भीतो भीते व्यपाश्रये। एकेन सात्वतेनाद्य युध्यमानस्य तेन वै॥
en: Who, seized with panic as he is, will care to remain, in the field of battle? Encountering that single-handed warriors of the Satvata race.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच संरब्धं फाल्गुनं दृष्ट्वा कालान्तकयमोपमम्॥ कर्णो वैकर्तनः सूत प्रत्यपद्यत् किमुत्तरम्।
en: Dhritarashtra said Seeing the wrathful Phalguna looking like Yama, the destroyer of time, what measures, O charioteer, did Karna, the son of Vikartana, adopt?

sa: देवतानां यथा स्कन्दः सेनानीः प्रभुरव्ययः। तथा भवानिमां सेनां धार्तराष्ट्रीं बिभर्तु वै॥
en: Therefore, do you maintain this force of Dhritarashtra, even as lord Skanda of eternal energy, the leader of the celestials, maintain the celestial force.

sa: तेषां युद्धं समभवद् दारुणं शोणितोदकम्। सिंहस्य द्विपमुख्याभ्यां प्रभिन्नाभ्यां यथा वने ॥
en: A cruel and sanguinary combat raged between them, like that between a lion and a pair of elephants in rut, in a forest. also,

sa: तस्य द्वेषेण संयुक्तः परिदह्ये धनंजय। आत्मनो मरणे यातो वाध्रीणस इव द्विपः॥ तस्यायमगमत् कालश्चिन्तयानस्य मे चिरम्। कथं कर्णो मया शक्तो युद्धे क्षपयितुं भवेत्॥
en: O Dhananjaya, I am burning with hatred against him. Conscious of my days being numbered I avoided Karna, like the bird Vaddrinasa. I approached him as if bent on my own destruction. Awake or asleep I spent my days only in thinking how I would accomplish Karna's death.

sa: ता वाचः सूतपुत्रस्य तथा युक्ता निशम्य तु। दुर्योधनो महाराज संदृष्टः सानुगोऽभवत्।॥
en: Hearing the words of the charioteer's son, which seemed proper to him, the great king Duryodhana, with all his followers, became filled with delight.

sa: तेन बाणेन निर्विद्धो वृषसेनो विशाम्पते। न्यपतत् स रथे मूढो धनुरुत्सृज्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: Baffing their as well as Karna's weapons with those of his own, O lord, Satyaki quickly pierced Vrishasena on the centre of his chest.

sa: द्रोणेन वार्यमाणास्ते स्वयं तव सुतेन च। नाशक्यन्त महाराज योधा वारयितुं तदा॥
en: Although, O great king, Drona himself and your son tried to rally them, yet they were not capable of reducing the warriors to order.

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते पार्थे पाण्डवाः सृञ्जयैः सह। भविष्यन्ति गतात्मानः सुरा इव निरग्नयः॥
en: Upon his slaughter, the rest of the Pandavas and the Srinjayas will be heartless like the god deprived of the fire in his mouth."

sa: तोमरं तु ततो गृह्य स्वर्णदण्डं दुरासदम्। प्रेषयत् समरे तूर्णं हार्दिक्यस्य युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Thereupon, taking up a formidable lance furnished with a golden handle, (Yudhishthira) hurled it, quickly in that engagement, against the high-souled son of Hridika.

sa: ततो वीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वाः सव्यसाचिदिदृक्षया। युधिष्ठिरो ददर्शाथ नैव पार्थ न माधवम्॥
en: Then longingly looking on all directions with the desire of having a sight of Partha, Yudhishthira was disappointed and saw neither Arjuna nor Madhava.

sa: यत्तो याहि रणे सूत शृणु चेदं वचः परम्। एतदालोक्यते सैन्यमावन्त्यानां महाप्रभम्॥
en: Yonder is seen the highly resplendent division of the Avantis. Next to them is the mighty host composed of the warriors from the south.

sa: संजय उवाच संग्रामाद् विनिवृत्तानां सर्वेषां नो विशाम्पते। रात्रौ कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रोऽयं समजायत॥ प्रभातमात्रे श्वोभूते केशवाया नाय वा। शक्तिरेषा हि मोक्तव्या कर्ण कर्णेति नित्यशः॥
en: Sanjaya said Every day returning from the field of battle, O ruler of men, we used to hold consultation in the night and speak unto Karna, O foremost of the Kurus, in the following manner. O Karna, tomorrow this Sakti should be hurled at either Karna or Arjuna."

sa: सुषेणो भीमसेनस्य च्छित्त्वा भल्लेन कार्मुकम्। नाराचैः सप्तभिर्विद्ध्वा हृदि भीमं ननाद ह॥
en: Cutting off with a broad headed bow, that of Bhimasena, Sushena pierced him on the breast with seven Narachas and made a loud war-cry.

sa: प्रविष्टे युयुधाने तु सैनिकेषु दुतेषु च॥ अमषीं कृतवर्मा तु सात्यकिं पर्यवारयत्।
en: When Yuyudhana had thus entered into the ranks of your soldiers and when your soldiers were breaking away, Kritavarman inspired with rage opposed Satyaki.

sa: ते त्वर्जुनं समासाद्य योधाः शतसहस्रशः। अगच्छन् विलयं सर्वे तायं दृष्ट्वेव पन्नगाः॥
en: Those hundreds of thousands of warriors all met with destruction at their approaching towards Arjuna, even as the snakes are all destroyed by Garuda.

sa: यथा वैतरणी राजन् यमराजपुरं प्रति। द्रावयित्वा तु तत् सैनयं धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Like, O monarch, the river Vaitarani carrying creatures to the abode of Death. Then the puissant Dhristadyumna completely routing that army of your son.

sa: तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा हस्तावापं निकृत्य च। प्राहिणोन्निशितान् बाणान् पञ्च राजञ्छिलाशितान्।। २८
en: The son of Pritha (however), cutting off his bow and armlet, shot at him, O king, five keen and broad-headed shafts sharpened on stone.

sa: शस्त्राणि च विचित्राणि क्रुद्धास्तव व्यदर्शयन्। छादयन्तः शरैः पार्थं मेघा इव दिवाकरम्॥
en: Inflamed with rage, they then displayed numerous wonderful weapons; and like the clouds covering the solar disc, they covered Pritha's son with their arrows.

sa: सादिभिः पत्तिसंघाश्च निहता युधि शेरते। मृदितानीव पद्मानि प्रम्लाना इव च स्त्रजः॥
en: The throngs of foot-soldiers, being slain by the horsemen, were lying on the field of battle, resembling the crushed lotuses and faded floral wreaths.

sa: विमृज्य नेत्रे पाणिभ्यां कृष्णं वचनमब्रवीत्। विदिता मे महाबाहो धर्माणां परमा गतिः॥
en: Wiping his eyes with his hands replied unto Krishna saying-O) you of mighty arms, the excellent path of duty is not unknown to you.

sa: तमहं जातु नास्येयमन्यस्मिन् फाल्गुनाहते। कृष्णाद् वा देवकीपुत्रात् सत्यं चापि शृणुष्व मे॥
en: I will not discharge this arrow at any other person excepting Arjuna or Krishna, the son of Devaki. Listen, I tell you the truth.

sa: संजय उवाच ततस्ते प्राद्रवन् सर्वे त्वरिता युद्धदुर्मदाः। अमृष्यमाणाः संरब्धा युयुधानरथं प्रति॥
en: Sanjaya said Then all those royal warriors of your army all indomitable in battle, furiously rushed against Yuyudhana's chariot, unable to brook his feats.

sa: नकुलं च त्रिसप्तत्या द्रौपदेयांश्च मारिष। पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा घोरं नादं ननाद ह॥
en: Then again, O sire, piercing Nakula with seventy-three and the sons of Draupadi, each with five arrows, he uttered a loud and dreadful war-cry.

sa: कथं वास्मासु जीवत्सु त्वयि चैव जनार्दन। हैडिम्बिः प्राप्तवान् मृत्युं सूतपुत्रेण सङ्गतः॥
en: How is it, O Janardana, that Hidimva's son met with death in his encounter with Suta's son, although you and ourselves are still alive?

sa: स च्छाद्यमानस्तु तदा द्रोणपुत्रेण मारिष॥ पार्थोऽययातः शीघ्रं वै विहाय महतीं चमूम्।
en: Thus covered, as it were, by the arrows of the son of Drona Pritha's son fled away from the field leaving his large army.

sa: न मया तादृशो राजन् दृष्टपूर्वः पराक्रमः। संग्रामे यादृशो द्रौणेः कृष्णौ संचादयिष्यतः॥
en: Never before, O monarch, did I witness such prodigies of valor like those displayed by Drouni when shrouding Krishna and Arjuna in the field.

sa: ते वचस्तस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवस्य भारत। ईषुः सर्वे समुत्स्रष्टुं मनोभिः करणेन च॥
en: Hearing those words of Vasudeva, O Bharata, all the Pandava warriors laid their weapons aside and discarded all thoughts of battle from their mind.

sa: कश्चिद् भीष्मेण नो वैरं शममेकेन यास्यति। शेषस्य रक्षणार्थ च संधास्यति सुयोधनः॥५५
en: Will our enmity end with the sacrifice of Bhima's self alone? Will Suyodhana conclude peace for the safety of the rest of the Kshatriyas?"

sa: अद्य कुन्तीसुतस्याहं दृढ राज्ञः प्रजागरम्। व्यपनेष्यामि गोविन्द हत्वा कर्णं शितैः शरैः॥
en: O Govinda, striking today the death knell of Karna with keen shafts, I will remove the long lost sleep of the son of Kunti.

sa: ततस्त्र्यङ्गेण महता बलेन भरतर्षभ। दृष्ट्वा परिवृतं राजन् भीमसेनः किरीमिनम्॥ हतावशेषानुत्सृज्य त्वदीयान् कतिचिद् रथान्। जवेनाभ्यद्रवद राजन् धनंजयरथं प्रति॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, Bhimasena, seeing the Kiritin was thus surrounded by the three different kinds of troops, O king, left the few remnant of your car warriors and quickly came up to Arjuna's car.

sa: तस्यापि च महाबाहो नित्यं पश्यामि संयुगे। नान्यं हि प्रतियोद्धारं रौक्मिणेयादृते प्रभो॥
en: I see every day, O mighty-armed one that except Rukmini's son there is no one who can be a match for Drona in battle,Omaster.

sa: गच्छामिस्वस्ति ते ब्रह्मन् न मे कालात्ययो भवेत्। आचार्यानुग्रतो मार्ग: शिष्यैरन्वास्यते सदा॥
en: The path which the preceptor follows it that which the pupil should follow. Therefore, I shall quickly follow that which my preceptor has followed.

sa: स तस्य गात्रावरणं भित्वा हृदयमेव च। जगाम धरणी तूर्णं महोरग इवाशयम्॥
en: That lance, having pierced through his armour and chest, immediately fell down upon the earth; even as the gigantic serpent enters into its hole.

sa: तान् स विद्ध्वा पुनर्योधान् वीरः सुनिशितैः शरैः। राधेयस्याच्छिनद् भल्लैः कार्मुकं चित्रयोधिनः॥
en: arrows on That head with its lips bitten, then fell on the field like a ripe palm-fruit thrown down by i a raging tempest.

sa: ततो योधैर्महाराज पलायद्भिः समन्ततः। अभवद् व्याकुलं भीतं पुत्राणां ते महद् बलम्॥
en: The warriors taking to their heels on all sides in numbers a great confusion took place in the vast terror-stricken army of your son.

sa: स गाढविद्धो बलिना भारद्वाजो महायशाः। निषसाद रथोपस्थे कश्मलं च जगाम ह॥
en: Pierced deeply by that powerful hero, the illustrious son of Bharadvaja, squatted down on the terrace of his chariot and fainted away in a

sa: द्रौणिना रक्ष्यमाणं च मया दुःशासनेन च। कथं प्राप्स्यति बीभत्सुः सैन्धवं कालचोदितः॥
en: How can Vibhatsu, who it appears is urged on by Fate, reach the Sindhu-king, who is protected by Drona's son and myself and Dushasana?

sa: पूर्व न समरे ह्येवमवधीदर्जुनो रिपून्। इदानीं विक्रमो ह्यस्य कृष्णेन सहितस्य च॥
en: Formerly Arjuna, indeed, never slaughtered his enemies in battle; but now, as he is always attended by Krishna, he shows forth such a prowess.

sa: कर्णद्रोणौ रणे पूर्वं हन्तव्याविति मे मतिः। एतौ हि मूलं दुःखानामस्माकं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Then, I think, Drona and Karna should have been slain ere now. O foremost of men, they are the cause of all our miseries.

sa: नापि स्वे न परे योधाः प्राज्ञायन्त परस्परम्॥ घोरे कर्णस्त्रे च विजृम्भिते।
en: The (atmosphere) became dark as pitch with the shower of arrows shot by Karna and nobody could know each other, or foes from friends.

sa: श्रुतवानसि कर्णस्य ब्रुवतो वदतां वर। यथा नृपतिसिंहानां मध्ये त्वां वरये स्वयम्॥
en: O best of speakers, you have heard what Karna had said, namely that this hero (Karna) chooses you amongst all the foremost of princes.

sa: यथा यथा ह्युयुध्यन्त पाण्डवानां महारथाः। तथा तथा तदस्रं वै व्यवर्धत जनाधिप॥
en: The weapon showed its exceeding strength in all those places, O ruler of men, where the great car-warriors of the Pandava hosts contended furiously.

sa: सा सीता भ्राजते तस्य रथमास्थाय मारिष॥ सर्वबीजविरूढेव यथा सीता श्रिया वृता।
en: O sire, that plough-share mounted on his chariot looked beautiful. Like the Goddess of corn incarnate, endued with all beauty and producing every seed.

sa: सर्वैः सहैभिर्दुष्टात्मा वध्यतां च प्रयत्नतः॥ त्वया यशश्च राज्यं च सुखं चोत्तममिच्छता।
en: That wicked man with all his followers should be killed by you with all care if you wish to secure fame, kingdom and happiness.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अधर्मेण हतं श्रुत्वा धृष्टद्युम्नेन संजय। ब्राह्मणं पितरं वृद्धमश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Hearing of the slaughter of his aged and Brahma-knowing sire by Dhristadyumna in an unfair battle, 0 Sanjaya, what did Ashvatthaman say.

sa: अर्जुनस्य महास्त्राणि क्रोधं वीर्य धनुः शरान्। अहं शल्याभिजानाभि विक्रमं च महात्मनः॥
en: O Shalya, I know that powerful weapons of Arjuna, his anger, energy, bow, arrows and as well as the prowess of that high-souled one.

sa: यच युष्मासु पापं वै धार्तराष्ट्रः प्रयुक्तवान्॥ तत्र सर्वत्र दुष्टात्मा कर्णः पापमतिर्मुखम्।
en: It is the profane and malignant Karna who is mainly responsible for all the evils that have been done to you by Dhritarashtra's son.

sa: प्रयातः सहसा राजन् सारथिं चेदमब्रवीत्। द्रोणः करिष्यते यत्नं सर्वथा मम वारणे॥
en: "Drona will put forth every effort to check me in battle. So proceed very carefully. Hear also these words of mine of grave import.

sa: तव ह्यत्र बलं भीमं मायाश्च तव दुस्तराः। संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य सततं भीमनन्दन॥
en: You are generous and your strength in battle is indeed terrible and matchless. While engaged in battle, there is none else equal to you.

sa: एतत् ते सुकृतं कर्म नात्र किंचन युज्यते। वयमप्यनूजानीमो नात्र दोषोऽस्ति कश्चन॥
en: It is your noblest duty; nor is there any impropriety in it; we all assent to it and there is no guilt in that.

sa: सात्यकिः शकुनि चापि द्रौपदेयाश्च कौरवान्। अर्जुनं च रणे यत्तो द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः॥
en: Satyaki proceeded against Shakuni and the sons of Draupadi against other Kauravas. And the great car-warrior Drona's son proceeded against Arjuna in that battle.

sa: छित्त्वा भीमो महाराज नादं सिंह इवानदत्। तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ बलिनौ वासितान्तरे॥
en: O mighty monarch, Bhima uttered a loud war-cry. Roaring at each other like two bulls for the sake of consorting with the same cow.

sa: पुत्रास्तु ते महाराज जग्मुः कर्णस्थ प्रति। अगाधे मज्जता तेषां द्वीपः कर्णोऽभवत्तदा॥
en: As persons, drowning in the deep sea, find shelter in an island, so your sons, O king, went towards Karna's car for their safety.

sa: सूतपुत्रं च संरब्धं पश्य कृष्ण महारणे। अन्तकप्रतिमं वीर्ये कुर्वाणं कर्म दारुणम्॥
en: Behold again in this great encounter O Krishna, the great son of a charioteer, resembling Death himself in power and performing a dreadful feat.

sa: स तं निर्भिद्य तेनास्तः सायकः सशरावरम्। विवेश वसुधा भित्त्वा श्वसन् बिलमिवोरगः॥
en: That arrow hurled by him, penetrating through the armour and the body of Satyaki, entered the earth like a hissing serpent entering its hole.

sa: अभयं यस्य भूतेभ्यो भूतानामभयं यतः। तस्य देहाद् विमुक्तस्य भयं नास्ति कुतश्चन॥
en: He who has no fear of any creature, and whom no creature fears, has, after, the dissolution of his body, no fear to meet.

sa: विद्या कर्म च शौचं न ज्ञानं च बहुविस्तरम् अर्थार्थमनुसार्यन्ते सिद्धार्थश्च विमुच्यते॥
en: One seeks the real object by means of learning, acts, purity and great knowledge. When that foremost of objects is acquired, one becomes liberated.

sa: यदि ब्राह्मण देहस्ते निरातङ्कोनिरामयः। अङ्गानि च समग्राणि न च लोकेषु धिक्कृतः॥
en: If this your regenerated body remains all right, and free from disease, and all your limbs remain perfect, you will incur reproach amongst men.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच श्रुतमेतत्त्वया राजन्नन्योः कथितं द्वयोः। प्रतिज्ञातं मया यत्ते तद् गृहाणाविचारितम्॥
en: The Brahmana said You have heard, O king, the words of these two. Do you take unhesitatingly what I have promised to give you.

sa: स्वभावादेव तत्सर्वमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः। आत्मप्रतिष्ठा प्रज्ञा वा मम नास्ति ततोऽन्यथा॥
en: All these come from Nature. This is my seitled belief. Even Liberation and knowledge of self, in my view, originate from the same Source.

sa: येन येन हि यस्यार्थः कारणेनेह कर्मणि। तत्तदालम्बते सर्वः स्वे स्वे स्वार्थपरिग्रहे॥
en: One becomes attached to all those things and acts which are necessary for him for the sake of his own self for particular reasons.

sa: ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरेशानां स्रष्टा च प्रभुरेव च। ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यं हि देवा उपासते॥
en: He is the creator of Brahman. Vishnu, and Indra, and he is their lord. All the gods, from Brahman to the Pishachas, adore him.

sa: उत्सहन्ते च ते वृत्तिमन्यामप्युपसेवितुम्। स्वकर्मणा तु नियतं भवितव्यं तु तत् तथा॥
en: They try to change such professions or better ones but then they are fettered by their pristine deeds and by the force of Destiny.

sa: यान् पूजयन्तो विन्दन्ति स्वर्गमायुर्यशः प्रजाः। तेषु त्वं सततं द्वेष्टा ब्राह्मणेषु निरर्थकः॥
en: You live in vain, for you, always entertain hatred and malice towards the Brahmanas,-by worshipping whom other men acquire long life, fame, and heaven.

sa: यानि यज्ञेष्विहेज्यन्ति सदा प्राज्ञा द्विजर्षभा। तेन ते देवयानेन पथा यान्ति महामुने।।३०
en: Gifted with wisdom, many leading Brahmanas celebrate Sacrifices. By performing those Sacrifices, they walk, O great ascetic, along the path wended by the gods.

sa: अस्य प्रवर्तनाच्चैव प्रजावन्तो भविष्यथ। स च राजश्रिया युक्तो भविष्यति महान् वसुः॥
en: For the publication of this treatise, you will be progenitors of an extensive family! King Uparichara also will become endued with greatness and prosperity.

sa: आंघ्रिको नैकदृक् चैव शिलायूपः शितः शुचिः। चक्रको मारुतन्तव्यो वातमोऽथाश्वलायनः॥ श्यामायनोऽश्च गार्यश्च जाबालिः सुश्रुतस्तथा। कारीषिरथ संश्रुत्यः परपौरवतन्तवः॥ महानृषिश्च कपिलस्तथर्षिस्ताडकायनः। तथैव चोपगहनस्तथर्षिश्चासुरायणः॥ मार्दमर्षिर्हिरण्याक्षो जङ्गारिर्बाभ्रवायणिः। भूतिर्विभूतिः सूतश्च सुरकृत् तु तथैव च॥ अरालि चिकाचैव चाम्पेयोज्जयनौ तथा। नवतन्तुर्बकनखः सेयनो यतिरेव च॥ अम्भोरुहश्चास्मत्स्यः शिरीषी चाथ गार्दभिः। उर्जयोनिरुदापेक्षी नारदी च महानृषिः॥ विश्वामित्रात्मजाः सर्वे मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः
en: Anghrika, Naikadrik, Shilayupa, Shita, Suchi, Chakraka, Marutantavya, Vataghna, Ashvalayana and Shyamayana, Gargya, and Javali, as also Sushruta, Karishi, Sangshrutya, and Par Paurava, and Tantu, the great sage Kapila, Tarakayana, Upagahana, Asurayani, Margama, Hiranyaksha, Janghari, Bhavravayani, and Suti, Bibhuti, Suta, Surakrit, Arani, Nachika, Champeya, Ujjayana, Navatantu, Vakanakhs, Sayana, Vati, Ambhoruha, Amatsyhin, Shirishin, Gardhavi, Urjjayoni, Udapekshin, and the great Rishi Naradin these ascetics were all sons of Vishvamitra and were versed in the knowledge of Brahma. O king Yudhishthira, the greatly austere and pious Vishvamitra, although a Kshatriya, became a Brahmana for Richika having placed the energy of supreme Brahma (in the charu), O foremost prince of Bharata's family

sa: विषयानुश्नुते यस्तु न स भोक्ष्यत्यसंशयम्। यस्तु भोगांस्त्यजेदात्मा स वै भोक्तुं व्यवस्यति॥
en: Verily, that man who enjoys earthly objects can never be liberated. That man, however, who renounces such objects, succeeds in enjoying great happiness hereafter.

sa: असद्भ्यो दीयते यत्तु तद् दानमिह भुज्यते। यादृशं दीयते दानं तादृशं फलमश्नुते॥
en: Whatever is given to those that are not good yields fruits in this world. The fruits of gifts are proportionate of the gifts offered.

sa: नैव संजायते जन्तुर्न च जातु विपद्यते। याति देहमयं मुक्त्वा कदाचित्परमां गतिम्॥
en: This individual is never born, nor does he ever die. Freed from the fetters of body, he succeeds sometimes in acquiring the highest end.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अतिक्रामति कालेऽस्मिन् सर्वभूतक्षयावहे। किं श्रेयः प्रतिपद्येत तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Time, which destroys every created thing, is rolling on. Tell me, O grandfather, what is that good thing which one should seek.

sa: न प्रहृष्येत लाभेषु नालाभेषु च चिन्तयेत्। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु सधर्मा मातरिश्वनः॥
en: He should not rejoice at an acquisition or be sorry at a failure or loss. Treating all beings equally he should imitate the wind.

sa: ब्राह्मणाः सर्व एवैते तत्यजुः सपुरोहिताः। स जगाम वनं राजा दह्यमानो दिवानिशम्॥
en: Upon this, all the Brahmanas together with his priests cast him off. Burning day and night with grief, the king retired into the forest.

sa: पुत्र उवाच मृत्युनाभ्याहतो लोको जरया परिवारितः। अहोरात्राः पतन्त्येते ननु कस्मान्न बुध्यसे॥
en: The son said Death is what assails the world. Decrepitude brings it about. Those irresistible objects which come and go away are the nights.

sa: न तत्र संवियुज्यते स्वकर्मभिः परस्परम्। यदेव यस्य यौतकं तदेव तत्र सोऽश्नुते॥
en: Acquired by one's own deeds, that wealth has never to be distributed among partners. Each enjoys that wealth which each has acquired for himself.

sa: एष तावत् समासेन तव संकीर्तितो मया। मोक्षार्थो विस्तरेणाथ भूयो वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु॥
en: Thus, O son, have I told you briefly. Hear me now, for I shall tell you fully, the desirability of the acquisition of Liberation.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा दानवेन्द्रौ तौ महाहासममुञ्चताम्॥ उचतुश्च समाविष्टौ रजसा तमसा च तौ। अयं स पुरुषः श्वेतः शेते निद्रामुपागतः॥ अनेन नूनं वेदानां कृतमाहरणं रसात्।
en: Seeing the Lord thus lying, the two foremost of Danavas roared out a loud laugh. Having the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance, they said. This is that Being of white complexion. He is no lying asleep. Forsooth, this one has brought the Vedas away from the nether region.

sa: यदा व्यपेतहल्लेखं मनो भवति तस्य वै। नानृतं चैव भवत तदा कल्याणपृच्छति॥
en: When one's mind becomes shorn of desire, and when all Darkness is removed from it, it is then that one acquires what is auspicious.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पापस्य यदधिष्ठानं यतः पापं प्रवर्तते। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं तत्त्वेन भरतर्षभ॥
en: Yudhishthira said-I wish, O foremost of Bharata's race, to hear fully the source from which sin proceeds and the basis upon which it depends.

sa: मया हि सुमहत् तप्तं तपः परमदारुणम्। पुरा मतिमतां श्रेष्ठाः परमेण समाधिना॥
en: You foremost of intelligent persons, I practised, in days of yore, the austerest penances, with the help of the highest abstraction of the mind.

sa: तामग्निश्चकमे साक्षाद् राजकन्यां सुदर्शनाम्। भूत्वा च ब्राह्मणो राजन् वरयामास तं नृपम्॥
en: The god Agni himself courted the beautiful princess Sudarshana, and assuming the shape of a Brahmana, O king, sought her hand from the king.

sa: यस्तु शत्रोर्वशस्थस्य शक्तोऽपि कुरुते दयाम्। हस्तप्राप्तस्य वीरस्य तं चैव पुरुषं विदुः॥
en: That person who, though able to punish, shows mercy towards a heroic enemies, defeated and brought under his control, is indeed a great man.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अष्टावक्रस्तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रतिगृह्य च तां प्रभो। कन्यां परमधर्मात्मा प्रीतिमांश्चाभवत् तदा॥
en: Bhishma said Ashtavakra said So be it! and espoused the girl. Indeed, having married the girl, the highly pious Rishi became filled with joy.

sa: त्राहि मां मातरं चैव तपो यच्चार्जितं मया। आत्मानं पातकेभ्यश्च भवाद्य चिरकारिकः॥
en: Save me, and your mother, and the penances I have won, as also your own self, from grave sins:-Be you truly a Chirakarika to-day!

sa: आत्मयज्ञो भविष्यामि न मां तारयति प्रजा। यस्य वाङ्मनसी स्यातां सम्यक् प्रणिहिते सदा॥ तपस्त्यागश्च योगश्च स तैः सर्वमवाप्नुयात्। नास्ति विद्यासमं चक्षुर्नास्ति विद्यासमं फलम्॥ नास्ति रागसमं दुःखं नास्ति त्यागसमं सुखम्॥
en: I shall celebrate the Sacrifice of Self, I require no children to rescue me. He whose words and thoughts are always well-governed, he who has penances and Renunciation, and Yoga, is sure to acquire everything through these. There is no eye like Knowledge. There is no reward like Knowledge. There is no sorrow like attachment. There is no happiness like Renunciation.

sa: चिरकारिक भद्रं ते भद्रं ते चिरकारिक। यद्यद्य चिरकारी त्वं ततोऽसि चिरकारिकः॥
en: Twice blessed be you, O Chirakarin! If on this occasion you have delayed accomplishing the work, then are you truly worthy of your name!

sa: न पुनर्जीवितः कश्चित् कालधर्ममुपागतः। प्रियो वा यदि वा द्वेष्यः प्राणिनां गतिरीदृशी॥
en: Whether friend or enemy, no one becomes alive having once yielded to the power of Time. Such, indeed, is the destiny of all creatures.

sa: यच्च प्राज्ञो नरस्तात सात्त्विकी वृत्तिमास्थितः॥ तस्यैश्वर्यं च धैर्यं च व्यवसायश्च कर्मसु।
en: That wise man, O sire, who always follows righteous conduct succeeds in acquiring prosperity, patience, and perseverance in the accomplishment of all his objects.

sa: ततो वैश्रवणो राजा भगवन्तमुवाच ह। साग्रः संवत्सरो जातो विप्रेह तव पश्यतः॥
en: Then king Vaishravana said to the Rishi O learned Brahmana, see a little more than a year has passed away since you arrival here.

sa: नैनानभ्युदियात् सूर्यो न चाप्यासन् प्रगेशयाः। रात्रौ दधि च सक्तूंश्च नित्यमेव व्यवर्जयन्॥
en: The Sun never rose while they lay asleep. They never slept when the Moon went away. They always abstained from curds and pounded barley.

sa: मया सृष्टः पुरा ब्रह्मा मां यज्ञमयजत् स्वयम्॥ ततस्तस्मिन् वरान् प्रीतो दत्त्वानसम्यनुत्तमान्।
en: In ancient times I created Brahman who himself worshipped me in sacrifices. Pleased with him on that account I granted him many excellent boons.

sa: वेदानृते हि कुर्यां लोकानां सृष्टिमुत्तमाम्। अहो बत महद् दुःखं वेदनाशनजं मम॥
en: Without the Vedas, how shall I succeed in starting my Creation? Alas, great is the grief I suffer for the loss of the Vedas.

sa: यजेद् देवं विरूपाक्षं न स पापेन लिप्यते। सर्वलक्षणहीनोऽपि युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः॥
en: A person who is shorn of every auspicious mark and who is stained by every sin, destroys all his sins by meditating upon Shiva.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु प्रववर्ष स वासवः। संजीवयन् प्रजाः सर्वा जनयामास चौषधीः॥
en: Meanwhile, the king of the gods began to pour profusely. Reviving all creatures by those showers, he made plants and herbs grow once more.

sa: पूर्वान् दश दश परान् पुनाति च पितामहान्। गृहस्थवृत्तीश्चाप्येता वर्तयेद् यो गतव्यथः॥
en: That man, who cheerfully lives like a householder, observing those duties, succeeds in sanctifying ten generations of his ancestors above and ten generations below.

sa: तेषां तेषां तथा हि त्वमाश्रमाणां ततस्ततः। नानारूपगुणोद्देशं पश्य विप्र स्थितं पृथक्॥
en: See, the merits of those modes of life, as described, are varied in their form, divergent in their matter, and contradictory in their observances.

sa: पृथिवी पर्वता मेघा मूर्तिमन्तश्च ये परे। सर्वं तद् वारुणं ज्ञेयमापस्तस्तम्भिरे यतः॥
en: Earth, mountains, clouds, and all things which have form, are all as transformations of water. They have all been produced by water being solidified.

sa: ये नृशंसा दुरात्मानः प्राणिप्राणहरा नराः। उद्वेजनीया भूतानां व्याला इव भवन्ति ते॥
en: Those cruel and wicked men who destroy the lives of other creatures are always like venomous snakes, a source of trouble to all creatures.

sa: तृतीयं ब्रह्मणो जन्म यदासीद् वाचिकं महत्। तत्रैष धर्मः सम्भूतः स्वयं नारायणानृप॥
en: In the third birth of Brahman which was from the speech of Narayana, this religion once more sprang up, O king, from Narayana himself.

sa: सु शृतं पायसे सायं प्रातश्च विप्राणां पूजनं च यथाविधि। पण्यानां शोभते पण्यं कृषीणां बाद्यते कृषिः॥ बहुकारं च सस्यानां बाह्ये वाहो गवां तथा।
en: The adoration of Brahmanas, morning and evening, according to due rites, yields great merit. Through such worship the stock of the merchant, and the produce of the agriculturist, become profuse. The produce of all sorts of corn and the supply of all articles of enjoyment also become profuse.

sa: सर्वावस्थं त्वमप्येषां द्विजातीनां प्रियं कुरु। इमे हि भूतले देवाः प्रथिताः कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Under all circumstances, O king, do you encompass what is agreeable to the twice-born, for these, O king, are known as gods on Earth.

sa: नास्ति ते सुखदुःखेषु विशेषो नासि लोलुपः। नौत्सुक्यं नृत्यगीतेषु न राग उपजायते॥
en: You see no difference between happiness and misery. You are not covetous. You have no desire for dancing and song. You have no attachments.

sa: ललाटाच्चैव मे रुद्रो देवः क्रोधाद् विनिःसृतः। पश्यैकादश मे रुद्रान् दक्षिणं पार्श्वमास्थितान्॥
en: The god Rudra, born of my anger, originated from my forehead. See, the eleven Rudras are increasing on the right side of my person.

sa: देवानां शरणं पुण्यं सर्वं पुण्यैरवाप्यते। पुण्यशीलं नरं प्राप्य किं दैवं प्रकरिष्यति॥
en: Virtue is the refuge of the gods, and by virtue everything is acquired. Destiny thwarts not the man who has acquired virtue and righteousness.

sa: मज्जन्ति पितरस्तस्य नरके शाश्वती: समा:॥ यो द्विष्याद् विबुधश्रेष्ठं देवं नारायणं हरिम्।
en: The ancestors of that person who hates Narayana, who is the foremost of gods, and is otherwise called Hari, sink into hell for good.

sa: नैव तस्यापरो लोको नायं पार्थिवसत्तम॥ कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यो द्विष्याद् विष्णुमव्ययम्।
en: Neither this world nor the next world is for him, O best of kings, who hates instead of loving and respecting the immutable Hari.

sa: अर्थो वा मित्रवर्गा वा ऐश्वर्यं वा कुलान्वितम्। श्रीश्चापि दुर्लभा भोक्तुं तथैवाकृतकर्मभिः॥
en: Riches, friends, prosperity coming down from generatica to generation, as also the sweets of life, are difficult of attainment by those who want Exertion.

sa: यदास्य तुल्यः पुरुषो न कश्चित् तत्र विद्यते। ततो व्याप्रैश्च सिंहैश्च द्विरदैश्चाप्ययोधयत्॥
en: When there was found no one such as to stand equal to him the king made him fight with tigers and lions and elephants.

sa: तया त्वभिहतो राजन् वेगवान् न्यपतद् भुवि। वातरुग्ण इव क्षुण्णो जीर्णमूलो वनस्पतिः॥
en: O king, thus struck with it, Vegavan fell on the ground like a faded, weather beaten and decayed-rooted lord of the forest (banian tree).

sa: आससाद रणे पार्थे केशवं च महारथम्। ततः सम्प्रहरन् वीरो गदामुद्यम्य भारत॥
en: And assaulted in that battle Pritha's son and also the mighty car-warrior Keshava. Then O Bharata that hero, up-lifting and striking with his mace.

sa: उपास्ते स्म सभायां यं कृत्स्ना वीर वसुन्धरा। तमुपासीनमप्यन्यं पश्य भारत भारतम्॥
en: 0 Bharata, behold that Bharata, who was worshipped by all the heroes of earth in court, even he is now serving another for subsistence.

sa: उत्तमौजा युयुत्सुश्च यमौ पार्घत एव च। चेदिकारूषमत्स्यानां केकयाना च यद् बलम्॥
en: And also Uttamanjas and Yuyutsu along with the twin brothers and the several divisions of the Chedis, the Karushas, the Matsyas and the Kaikeyas.

sa: एतचक्रं गदा शाई शङ्खः कृष्णस्य धीमतः। अत्यर्थ भ्राजते कृष्णे कौस्तुभस्तु मणिस्ततः॥
en: These are the discus, club, Sranga bow and the conch of the intelligent Krishna. The Kaustava jewel appears beautiful (on the breast of) Krishna.

sa: संछिन्दन्तौ च गात्राणि संदधानौ च सायकान्॥ दहन्तौ च शरोल्काभिर्दुष्प्रेक्ष्यौ च बभूवतुः।
en: Mangling each other's body, aiming their shafts at each other and burning each other with myriads of shafts, they could not be gazed at.

sa: गते वर्षसहस्र तु शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी। ददर्श यौवनं प्राप्ता ऋतुं सा चान्वचिन्तयत्॥
en: When one thousand years had passed away, Sharmishtha, the daughter of Vrishaparva, attained her puberty and her season came. She (therefore) began to ponder.

sa: वारणैः पतितै राजन् वाजिभिश्च नरैः सह। अदृश्यत मही कार्णा वातभग्नैरिव दुमैः॥
en: With fallen elephants, horses and men, the Earth became covered and looked as if covered with trees broken by the force of the wind.

sa: अहं तु कीर्तिपेतेषां कुरूणां भरतर्षभ। पाण्डवानां च सर्वेषां प्रथयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, as for myself, I shall vad the fame of the Kurus and the Pandavas. Do not therefore grieve.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किमर्थं सहसा विथ्यः प्रवृद्धः क्रोधमूर्छितः। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण महामुने॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O great Rishi, I am desirous of hearing why Vindhya (mountain), made senseless with anger, suddenly began to increase its bulk.

sa: चिराय तव पुत्राणां शतमेकश्च भारत। पाण्डोः पञ्चैव लक्ष्यन्ते तेऽपि मन्दाः सुदुःखिताः।
en: O descendant of Bharata, You possess one hundred and one children. Pandu has only five. They are in misery and they are greatly afflicted.

sa: देवा ऊचुः सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्मागं नक्षत्राणां गतिं तथा। शैलराजो वृणोत्येष विन्ध्यः क्रोधवशानुगः॥ तं निवारयितुं शक्तो नान्यः कश्चिद् द्विजोत्तम्। ऋते त्वां हि महाभाग तस्मादेनं निवारय॥
en: The celestials said: The king of mountains, Vindhya, giving way to anger, is obstructing the path of the sun and the moon and the course of the stars. O best of Brahimanas, O greatly exalted one, except you there is none who can prevent him from doing it.

sa: निमी राष्ट्रं च वैदर्भिः कन्यां दत्त्वा महात्मने। अगस्त्याय गतः स्वर्गे सपुत्रपशुबान्धवः॥
en: King Nimi of Vidarbha, acquired the celestial region with his sons, friends and cattle by giving his daughter and kingdom to the great Agastya.

sa: सोऽहं त्रस्तो भये मग्नो वने सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः। वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृतवैरश्च राघव॥
en: O Rāghava, my senses wildered, having been oppressed by Vāli, and having incurred his enmity, I am afflicted with fear, and tormented with fright.

sa: जलाहारो वायुभक्षः पर्णाहारश्च सोऽभवत्॥ तथा स्थाण्डिलशायी च ये चान्ये नियमाः पृथक्।
en: He lived on water, air and the fallen leaves of trees. He slept on the naked earth and practised other vows of the ascetics.

sa: ये चान्ये च महीपाला राजसूयं महाक्रतुम्। यजन्ते ते सहेन्द्रेण मोदन्ते भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, all the kings that perform the great Rajasuya sacrifices pass their time in bliss in company with Indra.

sa: अहो बत महत्कर्म रामस्य विदितात्मनः। अहो वीर्यमहो दाढयं विष्णोरिव हि दृश्यते॥
en: Ah! mighty is the feat achieved by Rāma knowing self. Ah! this mighty prowess, this mighty firmness, show like to those of Vişnu himself.

sa: इक्ष्वाकूणां हि सर्वेषां पुरोधाः परमा गतिः। न चातिक्रमतुं शक्यं वचनं सत्यवादिनः॥
en: To the Ikşvākus, their spiritual guide is their prime way; nor art you capable of setting at naught the words of that truth-telling one.

sa: स मामपृच्छत् कौन्तेय क्वासि गन्ता ब्रवीहि मे। तस्मा अवितथं सर्वमब्रुवं कुरुनन्दन॥
en: He asked me 'O son of Kunti, tell me where you will go' O son of Kuru, thereupon, I related to him everything faithfully.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच यथागतं गते शक्रे भ्रातृभिः सह सङ्गतः। कृष्णया चैव बीभत्सुर्धर्मपुत्रमपूजयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Sakra having left for his own abode. Vivatsu together with (his) brothers and Krishna paid homage to the son of Dharma.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य गेहे वै द्रौपद्याः परिचारिका। उषितास्मीति वक्ष्यामि पृष्टो राज्ञा च पाण्डव॥
en: O Pandava, on being asked by the king I shall say “I lived as a waiting maid of Draupadi in the palace of Yudhishthira.

sa: अहंकार बलं दर्प कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्। विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: Who is free from egoism, violence, pride, lust, wrath, surroundings, who is devoid of selfishness and is tranquil, become fit for assimilation with Brahma.

sa: तेन रत्नौषधिमता पुण्येन च सुगन्धिना। पाणिस्पर्शन राज्ञः स राजा संज्ञामवाप ह॥
en: At the touch of the king's hand which was auspicious and fragrant, and on which were jewels and medicinal herb's, Dhritarashtra regained his consciousness.

sa: किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं कार्यं यदिदमुद्यतम्॥ सुमहत् पाण्डुपुत्राणामायान्त्येते हि कौरवाः।
en: I am alone competent to achieve the mighty task the sons of Pandu have undertaken, heavy though it may be. Yonder come the Kauravas.

sa: स्थित्वा विष्टभ्य चरणौ भीमेन शिनिपुङ्गवः॥ निगृहीतः पदे षष्ठे बलेन बलिनां वरः।
en: Then Bhima firmly planting his feet, succeeded in stopping that foremost of all beings endowed with strength viz., that illustrious scion or Shini's race.

sa: स त्वमेवंविधं कृत्वा कर्म चाण्डालवत् स्वयम्॥ वक्तुमर्हसि वक्तव्यः कस्मात् त्वं परुषाण्यथ।
en: Having yourself perpetrated an act worthy of a Chandala only, it is strange that you desire to censure me in such a vile language.

sa: यदाज्ञानेन कुर्वीत गुणसर्ग पुनः पुनः। यदाऽऽत्मानं न जानीते तदाऽऽत्मापि न मुच्यते॥
en: When Soul, through ignorance, repeatedly becomes associated with qualities, he fails to understand his own real nature and therefore he fails to acquire Liberation.

sa: ते दानवा इवेन्द्रेण वध्यमाना महात्मना। पञ्चाला: केकया मत्स्याः समकम्पन्त भारत ६५।।
en: O Bharata, the Panchalas, the Kekayas and the Matsyas, thus slaughtered on all sides, like the Danavas by Indra, began to quake (with fear).

sa: क्षतजासवर्णाभा संध्या कालं बिना बभौ। खरं चाभिमुखं नेदुस्तदा घोरा मृगाः खगाः॥
en: And out of season, there appeared evening hued like a cloth soaked in blood. And facing Khara, terrible beasts and birds set up cries.

sa: एको वृक्षो हि यो ग्रामे भवेत् पर्णफलान्वितः। चैत्यो भवति निर्मातिरर्चनीयः सुपूजितः॥
en: Where there is only one tree full of leaves and fruits in a village, it became sacred and is worshipped and venerated by all.

sa: संजय उवाच विद्रुतं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा वध्यमानं महात्मभिः। क्रोधेन महताऽऽविष्टः पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding his own army carnaged by highsouled warriors, your son, O ruler of men, was excited to the highest pitch of fury.

sa: अगस्त्य उवाच आशीर्वादस्त्वया प्रोक्तः शपथो बलसूदन। दीयतां पुष्करं मह्यमेष धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Agastya said You have, O destroyer of Vala, uttered a benediction instead of a course. Give them to me, for that is eternal duty.

sa: राज्ञि धर्मानवेक्षस्व मा नः सर्वान् व्यनीनशः। सत्याच्च्युतिः क्षत्रियस्य न धर्मेषु प्रशस्यते॥
en: “O queen, turn your eyes on virtue. Do not destroy us all. The violation of truth in Kshatriyas is never praised in the scriptures.

sa: नकुलोऽपि धनं लब्ध्वा कृते कर्मणि वाजिनाम्। तुष्टे तस्मिन् नरपतौ पाण्डवेभ्यः प्रयच्छति॥
en: Nakula also gave the wealth to his brothers which he acquired from the king who was satisfied with him for his tending the horses.

sa: तत: कथास्ते समवाययुक्ताः कृत्वा विचित्राः पुरुषप्रवीराः। तस्थुर्मुहूर्तं परिचिन्तयन्तः कृष्णं नृपास्ते समुदीक्षमाणाः॥
en: Then those kings, heroes among men, having engaged in conversation with one another on various topics, remained for a moment gazing pensively on Krishna.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमागमनं तत्र कथयित्वाधनंजयः। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वै रजनी तामुवास ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus related the events in connection with his arrival there, Dhananjaya passed that night there together with all his brothers.

sa: स विजित्य महीपालांश्चकार वशवर्तिनः। चचार च सतां धर्मं प्राप चानुत्तमं यशः॥
en: The son of Dushyanta (Bharata) brought under his sway all the kings of the world. He ruled his subjects virtuously and gained great fame.

sa: इत्युक्ते वचने तस्मिन् प्रद्युम्नेन तथा त्वहम्। प्रत्यब्रुवं महाराज यत् तच्छृणु समाहितः॥
en: When Pradyuinna said, these words to me, I answered him as follows. Do you hear, O king, with rapt attention, what those words were.

sa: तस्मात् प्रहेष्याम्यद्य त्वां हीनः प्रजननात् स्वयम्। सदृशाच्छ्रेयसो वा त्वं विद्ध्यपत्यं यशस्विनि॥
en: As I am destitute of the power of procreation, I command you to raise illustrious offspring by some men equal or superior to me.

sa: स चापि निरनुक्रोशः क्षत्रयोनिः पिता तव। विश्वामित्रो ब्राह्मणत्वे लुब्धः कामवशं गतः॥
en: Your father also is lustful Vishvamitra of the Kshatriya race, destitute of all affection, the ! man who was tempted to become a Brahmana.

sa: स तु सम्पूजजितस्तेन सह मातृगणेन ह। परिवार्य महासेनं रक्षमाणः स्थितः शिवः॥
en: That Sive (the doer of good) was duly honoured by his son; and he with the mothers stayed there near Mahasena to tend him.

sa: अग्निः प्रनष्टो भगवान् कारणं च न विद्महे॥ सर्वभूतक्षयो राजन् सम्पादय विभोऽनलम्।
en: And they said-"The worshipful Agni has disappeared. We do not know the reason. Let not creation go to destruction. Create fire, O powerful Lord?"

sa: प्रमृते मयिधर्मात्मन् पुत्रदारादि नक्ष्यति। रक्षमाणः कपोतं त्वं बहून् प्राणान् न रक्षसि॥
en: O virtuous-minded one, at my death my wife and children will perish. By protecting the pigeon you do not (at all) protect many lives.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा दुहितरं तथा वृद्धांश्च मन्त्रिणः। व्यादिदेशानुयात्रं च गम्यतां चेत्यचोदयत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Addressing thus his daughter and his old ministers, (the king) gave orders to make preparations (for their departure) and said "go".

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु तत् सर्वं स्वनुरक्तः सुहज्जने। दूतानुवाच भरतः कामैः सम्प्रतिपूज्य तान्।६।।
en: Taking all these, Bharata attached to his relatives, made the articles over to them; and receiving the envoys with goodly gifts, spoke to them.

sa: अन्तर्हितायां सावित्र्यां जगाम स्वपुरं नृपः। स्वराज्ये चावसद् वीरः प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: When Savitri had disappeared the king entered his own city. And that hero began to dwell in his kingdom and govern his subjects righteously.

sa: संजय उवाच मध्यन्दिने महाराज संग्रामः समपद्यत। लोकक्षयकरो रौद्रो भीष्मस्य सह सोमकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said At mid day, 0 mighty monarch, commenced a combat between the Somakas and Bhishma, that become dreadful and destructive of many creatures.

sa: यथा मत्सङ्गमे पूर्वं यः कृतः समयस्त्वया। तं स्मरस्व महाभाग कण्वाश्रमपदं प्रति॥
en: O illustrious man, call to your mind the agreement you made with me on the occasion of our marriage at the hermitage of Kanva.

sa: स सव्यं मण्डलं राजा उद्भ्राम्य कृतनिश्चयः॥ आजम्ने मूर्ध्नि कौन्तेयं गदया भीमवेगया।
en: Adopting the left Mandala, O king, and whirling his mace, Suyodhana, then struck the son of Kunti on the head with his terrible weapon.

sa: संजय उवाच द्रोणस्य तद् वचः श्रुत्वा त्रिगर्ताधिपतिस्तदा। भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereat, having listened to these words of Drona, the ruler of the Trigarttas united with his brothers, spoke these words, O monarch.

sa: त्वया पुनर्नृशंसेन सीतां संरुन्धता बलात्। राक्षसा बयमात्मा च त्रयं तुल्यं निपातितम्॥
en: By there, Sītā was kept by force in captivity in a ruthless manner, and the Rākşasas, ourselves and yourself-all three equally have been slain.

sa: अभिभूय स मां बालां तेजसा वशमानयत्। तमसा लोकमावृत्य नौगतामेव भारत॥ मत्स्यगन्धो महानासीत् पुरा मम जुगुप्सितः। तमपास्य शुभं गन्धमिमं प्रादात् स मे मुनिः॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, he overpowered me, a mere girl, by his great effulgence and he also enveloped the region with a thick fog. There was in my body a revolting odour of fish before, but the Rishi dispelled it and gave me my this fragrance.

sa: पश्य शीतजलां चेमां सौमित्रे पुष्करायुताम्। चक्रवाकानुचरितां कारण्डवनिषेविताम्॥ प्लवैः क्रौञ्चैश्च सम्पूर्णां महामृगनिषेविताम्।
en: O Saumitri, behold this Pampā of cool water, enveloped on all sides with lotuses, and frequented by Cakravākas, Karandavas, Krauñcas, Plavas and high deer.

sa: नश्वान् रथान् पत्तिगणान् द्विपांश्च। ते पेतुरुवा॒ बहुधा विरूपा वातप्रणुन्नानि यथा वनानि॥
en: Umbrellas, banners, horses, chariots, elephants and foot soldiers, shattered and mutilated, fell down on the Earth, like a forest uprooted by a violent wind.

sa: तया विहीनः कृपणः कथं लक्ष्मण धारये। या मामनुगता राज्याद् भ्रष्टं विहतचेतसम्॥
en: How shall I keep up (my being) being poorly, O Lakşmaņa, being forsaken by that Sītā who followed me, deprived of kingdom and sense?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रज्वलिते वह्नौ शाईकास्ते सुदुःखिताः। व्यथिताः परमोद्विग्ना नाधिजग्मुः परायणम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: When the fire blazed up the Sharangakas became very much distressed. Afflicted with anxiety, they did not fine any means of escape.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो रणे भीमः शरं रुक्मविभूषितम्॥ प्रेषयामास स रुषा सौबलं प्रति भारत।
en: Being thus smitten in battle, O Bharata, Bhima, then flung, all of a sudden, a shaft laid with gold upon the son of Subala.

sa: यत्रास्ते देवराजोऽसौ तं देशं दर्शयस्व मे। इत्याहोपश्रुतिं देवीं सत्यं सत्येन दृश्यताम्॥
en: Show me the spot where stays he the king of gods. Show me truth by means of truth. Thus did she ask of Upashruti.

sa: तथा ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे भार्गवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। भयानां शृणु यन्मूलं देशस्य च नरेश्वर॥
en: As Käkutstha was speaking thus, Bhārgava remarked! O lord of men, do you hear of the origin of the fear that threatens our country.

sa: इति सर्वा महिष्यस्ता विवत्सा इव धेनवः। रुरुदुश्चैव दुःखार्ताः सस्वरं च विचुक्रुशुः॥
en: Thus all the queens, oppressed with grief, burst out into lamentations like kine bereft of calves, and loud was the sound of their wailing.

sa: आमिषं बन्धनं लोके कर्मेहोक्तं तथामिषम्। ताभ्यां विमुक्तः पापाभ्यां पदमाप्नोति तत् परम्॥
en: Worldly enjoyments are called fetters. They have also been called Action Freed from the sinful fetters of action, one attains to the highest end.

sa: स ते विक्रमशौटीरो रणे पार्थं विजेष्यति। कर्णः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः सर्वांश्चारीन् महारथः॥
en: That great car-warrior, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, proud of his prowess, will vanquish Arjuna in battle, as also all your enemies.
