sa: शूरेण धनदभ्रात्रा बलैः समुदितेन च। श्लाघनीयं महत्कर्म यशस्यं च कृतं त्वया॥
en: A great and famous act has been performed by you, a hero, and the brother of the Bestower of riches, surrounded with your forces!

sa: स तु तेन प्रहारेण न चचाल महाकपिः। परिघेण समाधूतो यथा भूमिचलेऽचलः॥
en: Like to a mountain standing still even at the time of an earthquake that mighty monkey was not moved albeit struck with the parigha.

sa: अलमद्य हि भूक्तेन परमार्थैरलं च नः। यदि पश्याम निर्यान्तं रामं राज्य प्रतिष्ठितम्॥ ततो हि नः प्रियतरं नान्यत् किंचिद् भविष्यति। यथाभिषेको रामस्य राज्येनामिततेजसः॥
en: Seek not we earthly comforts or the highest things (in the life to come), if we can only see. Rāma installed in the kingdom issuing out from his father's abode. There is nothing more pleasant to us than the installation of the highly energetic Rāma on the throne.

sa: केचिदेव महाप्राज्ञाः प्रतिज्ञास्यन्ति तत्त्वतः। जानीहि मत्कृतं तात ब्राह्मणान् प्रति भारत।॥ यथा ते मत्कृते क्षेमं लभन्ते ते तथा कुरु। प्रतिजानीहि चाद्रोहं ब्राह्मणानां नराधिप॥
en: The wise will understand me aright. Know, O child, what are my views, O Bharata, regarding the Brahmanas. Do you act in such a way that they may, through my efforts, obtain every blessing! Do you also, O king, promise that you will not again injure the Brahmanas.

sa: ये च त्वां घोरचक्षुभिः पश्यन्ति प्राणिनो भुवि। हतास्ते यमदण्डेन सद्यो निरयगामिनः॥
en: Those on earth, who cast dreadful looks on you, are immediately brought under the control of Yama and are constrained to go to hell.

sa: श्वशुराय तत: कुन्ती प्रणम्य शिरसा तदा॥ उवाच वाक्यं सव्रीडा विवृण्वाना पुरातनम्॥
en: At this, Kunti, bending her head to herfather-in-law, and overcome with bashfulness, said these words to him, recounting the past incidents of her life.

sa: यज्ञं त्वहमिमं श्रुत्वा कुरुराजस्य धीमतः॥ आशया परया प्राप्तो न चाहं काञ्चनीकृतः।
en: Hearing of this sacrifice of the Kuru king, gifted with great wisdom, I came here with hopes. I have not, however, been made gold.

sa: शरीरग्रहणं चास्य केन पूर्वं प्रकल्पितम्। इत्येवं संशयो लोके तच्च वक्ष्याम्यत: परम्॥
en: There is a doubt in the world about this question. By what was the acceptance (by the individual Soul) of a body first determined.

sa: ब्राह्मणा यं प्रशंसन्ति पुरुषः स प्रवर्धते। ब्राह्मणैर्यः पराकृष्टः पराभूयात् क्षणाद्धि सः॥
en: That man whom the Brahmanas praise succeeds in becoming prosperous. That man who is censured and renounced by the Brahmanas soon meets with discomfiture.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अदृष्ट्वा स महीपालस्तमृषि सह भार्यया। परिश्रान्तो निववृते वीडितो नष्टचेतनः॥
en: Bhishma said Not seeing the Rishi, the king, Stricken with shame, toilworn, and losing his senses, returned to his palace, accompanied by his queen.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं मया परपुरंजय। यदाश्चर्यमभूत् तत्र वाजिमेधे महाक्रतौ॥
en: Vaishmpayana said O conquerer of hostile towns, I have now told you all about that wonderful incident which took place in that great Horse-Sacrifice.

sa: अहिंसा परमो धर्मस्तथाहिंसा परं तपः। अहिंसा परमं सत्यं यतो धर्मः प्रवर्तते।॥
en: Abstention from injury is the highest Religion. It is, again, the highest penance. It is also the highest truth from which all duty emanates.

sa: वन्दितो हि स वन्देत मानितो पानयीत च। अर्हितश्चाई येन्नित्यं पूजितः प्रतिपूजयेत्॥
en: Adored, he adores, and honoured, he honors; to them who make offerings to him, he makes offerings in return. Worshipped, he worships in return.

sa: व्यास उवाच श्रुत्वा तु पार्थिवस्यैतत् संवर्तः प्रमुदं गतः। एतावदहमप्येवं शक्नुयामिति सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vyasa said Hearing these words of the king Marutta, Samvarta was highly pleased, and he said-I too am perfectly able to do all that.

sa: इति मे वर्तते बुद्धिर्मा नो निन्दन्तु शत्रवः। कष्टात्कष्टतरं यान्तु सर्वे दुर्योधनादयः॥
en: This is what I think. Let not our enemies be gladdened. Let Duryodhana and others sink from a miserable to a more miserable position.

sa: एवं वर्षाण्यतीतानि धृतराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः। वनवासे तथा त्रीणि नगरे दश पञ्च च॥
en: Thus did king Dhritarashtra make his departure from this world after having passed three years in the forest and fifteen years in the city.

sa: तस्माद् ब्रजस्थानगतस्तिष्ठत्युपरि मे वृषः। रमेऽहं सह गोभिश्च तस्मात् पूज्याः सदैव ताः॥
en: It is therefore, that emblem of bull stands on my standard overhead. I always sport with kine. Hence, should kine be adored by all.

sa: अधर्मनिरतो मूढो मिथ्या यो वै द्विजातिषु। दद्यान्मर्मातिगं शोकं तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that foolish and sinful wightought to be guilty of Brahmanicide who pains the Brahmanas to the very core of their hearts.

sa: इयं च द्रौपदी कृष्णा हतज्ञातिसुता भृशम्। शौचत्यतीव सर्वासां स्नुषाणां दयिता स्नुषा॥
en: This Krishna, the daughter of Drupada, has lost all her kinsmen and children. Therefore, she who is the dearest of my daughters-in-law grieves greatly.

sa: नैनं शस्त्राणि विध्यन्ते न मृत्युश्चास्य विद्यते। नातः सुखतरं किंचिल्लोके क्वचन दृश्यते॥
en: Weapons never pierce him; death does not exist for him. Nowhere in the world can be seen any one who is happier than he.

sa: ततः प्रासांश्च शक्तीश्च पुनरेव धनंजयम्॥ जयद्रथं हतं स्मृत्वा चिक्षिपुः सैन्धवा नृपाः।
en: The Saindhava Kshatriyas, recollecting that it was Dhananjaya who had killed their king Jayadarth, then hurled at him darts and javelins with great force.

sa: पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च द्यां चैव मधुसूदन। हसितं तेऽमला ज्योत्स्रा ऋतवश्चेन्द्रियाणि ते॥
en: You create the Earth, the Sky, and Heaven, O Destroyer of Madhu. The stainless Lunar light is your smile. The seasons are your senses.

sa: अन्नाद् गृहस्था लोकेऽस्मिन् भिक्षवस्तापसास्तथा। अन्नाद् भवन्ति वै प्राणा: प्रत्यक्षं नात्र संशयः॥
en: All classes of men, householders and mendicants and ascetics, live upon food. The vital airs depend upon food. There is no doubt in this.

sa: इत्युक्त्वाऽऽदाय तान् सक्तून् प्रीतात्मा द्विजसत्तमः। प्रहसन्निव विप्राय स तस्मै प्रददौ तदा॥
en: Having said this, that foremost of twiceborn persons cheerfully took his son's share of the barley and smilingly presented it to his twice-born guest.

sa: घृतं मासे आश्वयुजि विप्रेभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति। तस्मै प्रयच्छतो रूपं प्रीतौ देवाविहाश्विनौ॥
en: The twin Ashvins, pleased, confer personal beauty upon that man who makes gifts of clarified butter to the Brahmanas in the month of Ashvin.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु तान् विप्रान् प्रत्युवाच महामनाः॥ भ्रातृभिः सहितो धीमान् मध्ये राज्ञां महात्मनाम्।
en: The great Yudhishthria of great intelligence staying with his brothers in the midst of the kings invited to his sacrifice, said to those Brahmanas:

sa: पूयन्ते तत्र नियतं प्रयच्छन्तो वसुन्धराम्। सर्वे च कथिता धर्मास्त्वया मे कुरुनन्दन॥
en: By always making, however, gifts of earth, they succeed in purifying themselves. You have, O prince of Kuru's race, describe to me many duties.

sa: सुखादेव परं दुःखं दुःखादप्यपरं सुखम्। दृश्यते हि महाप्राज्ञ नियतं वै स्वभावतः॥
en: It is always observed, O you of great wisdom to happen naturally that happiness is followed by misery, and misery is followed by happiness.

sa: यस्य स्म विषये राज्ञः स्नातकः सीदति क्षुधा। अवृद्धिमेति तद्राष्ट्रं विन्दते सहराजकम्॥
en: That kingdom in which a Brahmana of the Snataka class starves, becomes overwhelmed with adversity. Such a kingdom with its king also incurs reproach.

sa: शुनःसख उवाच न्यस्तमद्यं न पश्यद्भिर्यदुक्तं कृतकर्मभिः। सत्यमेतन्न मिथ्यैतद् बिसस्तैन्यं कृतं मया॥
en: Shunasakha said Not seeing the lotusstalks deposited by you, what you say is indeed true, for it is I who have actually stolen them.

sa: बहुना च किमुक्तेन गम्यतां यत्र वाञ्छसि। वपुष्मन्त्यो वयं सर्वाः किमस्माकं त्वयानघे॥
en: What need of much talk? Go wherever you like. All of us have excellent forms. What need have we with you, O sinless one?

sa: सत्कृत्य ते तां सरितं ततः कृष्णमुखा नृप। अनुज्ञातास्तया सर्वे न्यवर्तन्त जनाधिपाः॥
en: O monarch, having honoured that goddess duly all the kings there present, headed by Krishna, received her permission to go away from her banks.

sa: तत्रैकगुणमाकाशं शब्द इत्येव च स्मृतः। तस्य शब्दस्य वक्ष्यामि विस्तरेण बहून् गुणान्॥
en: Now, space has only one quality, and that is said to be sound. I shall speak at length of the numerous qualities of sound.

sa: एष एव परो धर्मो राजर्षीणां युधिष्ठिर। समरे वा भवेन्मृत्युर्वने वा विधिपूर्वकम्॥
en: This is the highest duty, O Yudhishthira, of royal sages. They should die either in battle or in the forest according to the scriptures.

sa: अर्जुनं च समाश्लिष्य यमौ च पुरुषर्षभौ॥ अनुजज्ञे स कौरव्यः परिष्वज्याभिनन्द्य च।
en: Embracing Arjuna and clasping those foremost of men, viz., the twins also, and blessing them repeatedly, the Kuru king gave them permission to go.

sa: ततः स्मयन्ती पाणिभ्यां नर्मार्थं चारुहासिनी। हरने शुभे देवी सहसा सा समावृणोत्॥
en: With smiling lips and desirous of playing a jest, the beautiful Uma covered from behind, with her two beautiful hands, the eyes of Mahadeva.

sa: न च ते प्रसभं यस्मात् ते निगृह्य निवारिताः। तस्मान्मन्युपरीतस्त्वां शप्स्यामि मधुसूदन॥
en: Since you did not forcibly compel them to forbear, therefore, O destroyer of Madhu, I shall, filled with anger denounce a course on you.

sa: तस्मात्त्वमपि तं कामं यज्ञैर्विविधदक्षिणैः। धर्मे कुरु महाराज तत्र ते स भविष्यति॥
en: Therefore, you too, O prince, divert your desires (Kama) to virtue, so that, by this means, you may attain what is for your good.

sa: तत: प्रासादहर्येषु वसुधायां च पार्थिव। नारीणां च नराणां च नि:स्वनः सुमहानभूत्॥
en: Great was the uproar, at that time, O king, of both men and women standing on the terraces of palaces or on the Earth.

sa: स कुलीन: स पुरुषः स बन्धुः स च पुण्यकृत्। स दाता स च विक्रान्तो यो ददाति वसुन्धराम्॥
en: That king who makes gifts of earth, is considered as wellborn. He is considered as a man. He is a friend. He is righteous in his acts. le is a giver. He is considered as possessing prowess.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि मनो युङ्क्ते सदश्वानिव सारथिः। इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिः क्षेत्रज्ञे युज्यते सदा॥
en: The mind yokes the senses, as a charioteer yokes good horses. The senses, the mind, and the understanding are always joined to the Soul.

sa: न हि तेजस्विनां शापास्तेजःसु प्रभवन्ति वै। बलान्यतिबलं प्राप्य दुर्बलानि भवन्ति वै॥
en: The curses of the energetic cannot produce any effect upon the energetic. Forces, when they come into contact with a stronger force, become weakened.

sa: अभिवादितो वधूभिश्च कृष्णाद्याभिः स पार्थिवः। गान्धार्या सहितो धीमान् कुन्त्या च प्रत्यनन्दत॥
en: Saluted with respect by all his daughters-inlaw headed by Krishna, king Dhritarashtra, gifted with great intelligence, with Gandhari and Kunti became filled with joy.

sa: प्रत्यक्षदर्शी सर्वस्य पित्रा पृष्टो महात्मना। स तां वार्ता पितुर्मध्ये महर्षीणां न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Thus asked by his great father. Nachiketa who had seen every thing with his own eyes, answered thus in the midst of the Rishis.

sa: सर्वे चासन् निरुत्साहा: पाण्डवा जातमन्यवः। कुन्त्या हीनाः सुदुःखार्ता वत्सा इव विनाकृताः॥
en: Afflicted with grief, the Pandavas were shorn of energy. Abandoned by Kunti, they were deeply afflicted with grief, like calves destitute of their dais.

sa: उमोवाच अयं भगवता प्रोक्तः प्रश्वः स्त्रीधर्मसंश्रितः। तं तु सम्मन्त्र्य युष्माभिर्वक्तुमिच्छामि शंकरम्॥
en: Uma said The illustrious god has asked a question about the duties of women. I wish to answer Shankara after having consulted with you.

sa: पुनः पुनश्च वार्ष्णेयं पर्यष्वजत फाल्गुनः। आ चक्षुर्विषयाच्चैनं स ददर्श पुनः पुनः॥
en: Phalguna repeatedly embraced the Vrishni hero and as long as he was within he range of eye-sight he repeatedly turned his eyes towards him.

sa: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्। जन्मादिमूर्तिभेदान्तं कर्म भूतेषु वर्तते॥
en: From birth to the attainment of a different form, action good or bad, and accomplished by deeds, mind, or speech, exists in all beings.

sa: न च मन्युस्त्वया कार्य इति त्वां प्राह धर्मराट्। संस्मृत्य भीमस्तद्वैरं यदन्यायवदाचरत्॥ एवं प्रायो हि धर्मोऽयं क्षत्रियाणां नराधिप। युद्धे क्षत्रियधर्मे च निरतोऽयं वृकोदरः॥
en: King Yudhishthira the just has prayed you not to be displeased for the improper conduct which Bhima has shown at the recollection of foriner hostilities. This is generally the conduct of Kshatriyas in battle, O king, and this Vrikodara is devoted to battle and the practices of Kshatriyas.

sa: ब्राह्मणैः सहिता यान्ति तस्मात् पारमकं पदम्॥ एकं गोब्राह्मणं तस्मात् प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः।
en: And since kine attain to the highest end, in the company of Brahmanas, therefore do the wise say that kine and Brahmanas are equal.

sa: वेदाध्यायी गोषु यो भक्तिमांश्च नित्यं दत्त्वा योऽभिनन्देत गाश्च। आजातितो यश्च गवां नमेत इदं फलं शक्र निबोध तस्य॥
en: Hear, O Shakra, what the merit is of that person who, duly studying the Vedas, shows respect for kine, who always becomes glad on seeing kine, and who since his birth always bows his head to kine.

sa: दिव्यज्ञानबलोपेता गान्धारी च यशस्विनी। ददर्श पुत्रांस्तान् सर्वान् ये चान्येऽपि मृधे हताः॥
en: Gifted with celestial knowledge and strength, the illustrious Gandhari beheld all her children as also all those who had been killed in battle. son

sa: विशेषं चैव कर्तास्मि पुनः पुनरतीव हि। अद्येह स्वर्णमभ्येतु यच्चान्यद् वसु किंचन॥
en: I can even repeatedly create a different order of things. Let gold and whatever else of riches there is, come to this place today.

sa: अन्नं हि परमं गावो देवानां परमं हविः। स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ गोषु नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ॥
en: Kine from the highest food. They are the best Havi for the celestials. The Mantras called Svaha and Vashat are forever established in kine.

sa: तत् तु सर्वे यथान्यायमुक्तः कुरुकुलोद्वहः। चकार फाल्गुनं चापि संदिदेश हयं प्रति॥
en: Thus addressed by the Rishi, that perpetuator of Kuru's race, viz., Yudhishthira, performed every injunction duly and appointed Phalguna to attend to the horse.

sa: बलदेव उवाच श्रूयतां परमं गुह्यं मानुषाणां सुखावहम्। अजानन्तो यदबुधाः क्लिश्यन्ते भूतपीडिताः॥
en: Baladeva said Listen now to another great mystery that yields happiness to men. Unacquainted with it, ignorant persons suffer much distress from other creatures.

sa: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा फाल्गुनस्य महात्मनः। विदुरं प्राह धर्मात्मा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ इदं मद्वचनात् क्षत्तः कौरवं ब्रूहि पार्थिवम्। यावदिच्छति पुत्राणां श्राद्धं तावद् ददाम्यहम्॥ भीष्मादीनां च सर्वेषां सुहृदामुपकारिणाम्। मम कोशादिति विभो मा भूद् भीम: सुदुर्मनाः॥
en: Hearing these words of the great Phalguna, the righteous-souled Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, addressed Vidura and said these words, "Instructed by me, O Kshatri, do you say to the Kuru king that I shall give him as much wealth from my treasury as he wishes to give away for the obsequies of his sons, and of Bhishma and others among his well-wishers and benefactors, let not Bhima be dispirited at this.

sa: सा ह्यग्रे गच्छति तयोर्दम्पत्योर्हतपुत्रयोः। कर्यन्ती तौ ततस्ते तां दृष्ट्वा संन्यपतन भुवि॥
en: She was walking in advance of the childless old pair, and was dragging them forward. Seeing her, the Pandavas feel down on the earth.

sa: हुष उवाच सहस्रं दीयतां मूल्यं निषादेभ्यः पुरोहित। निष्क्रयार्थे भगवतो यथाऽऽह भृगुनन्दनः॥
en: Nahusha said Let my priest give to these Nishadas a thousand coins as price for buying this sacred one as he himself has ordered.

sa: क्षेत्रं हि दैवतमिदं ब्राह्मणान् समुपाश्रितम्। अमलो ह्येष तपसा प्रीतः प्रीणाति देवताः॥
en: The body of the Brahmana is the divine field. By penance, it is purified. Then again, by pleasing the Brahmana, one pleases the celestials.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच हन्त वः संप्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां पृच्छथ सत्तमाः। गुरुणा शिष्यमासाद्य यदुक्तं तन्निबोधत॥
en: Well then I shall describe to you what you ask. Learn what was told by a preceptor to a disciple who came to him.

sa: आह्वानं च प्रयुञ्जीत समझे बहुलेति च। प्रविश्य च गवां मध्यमिमां श्रुतिमुदाहरेत्॥
en: The kine also should be addressed with the wordsSamange and BahuleEntering the fold where the kine are kept, the following Shrutis should be uttered:

sa: विदितास्ते स्त्रियो याश्च यादृशाश्च स्वभावतः। न मामर्हसि देवर्षे नियोक्तुं कार्य ईदृशे॥
en: You know what women are and with what nature they are gifted. You should not, O celestial Rishi, set me to such a task.

sa: अब्रवीत् किल दाशार्ह वैराटीमा निस्तदा। मातुलस्य कुलं भद्रे तव पुत्रो गमिष्यति॥
en: O you of the Dasharha-race. Arjuna's son said to this daughter of Virata, Your son, O blessed girl, will go to my maternal uncles.

sa: रामो व्यासस्तथा द्रौणिरश्वत्थामा च लोमशः। इत्येते मुनयो दिव्या एकैकः सप्त सप्तधा॥
en: Rama, Vyasa, Drona's son Ashvatthama, are the other Rishis. These are the great Rishis as divided into seven groups, cach group consisting of seven.

sa: य एतां विदुषे दद्यात् पृथिवीं पृथिवीपतिः। पृथिव्यामेतदिष्टं स राजा राज्यमितो व्रजेत्॥
en: The gift of earth is desirable. That king who makes a gift of earth to a learned Brahmana, gets from that gift a kingdom.

sa: ज्योतिस्तेजः प्रकाशं वाप्यूर्ध्वगं चापि वर्ण्यते। प्रदानं तेजसां तस्मात् तेजो वर्धयते नृणाम्॥
en: Light is said to be energy and fame and goes upwards. Hence the gift of light, which is energy, increases the energy of men.

sa: न भयं विद्यते जातु नरस्येह दयावत:॥ दयावतामिमे लोका: परे चापि तपस्विनाम्।
en: A kind-hearted man seldom has to suffer from any fright. A gracious and austerious person enjoys equal pleasure in this world and the next.

sa: पुत्रेण घातयित्वैनं पतिं यदि न मेऽद्य वै। जीवन्तं दर्शयस्यद्य परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: If, having killed your husband through your son, you do not revive him today before my eyes, I shall then renounce my own lifebreaths.

sa: निर्वापयन्तो ज्वलनं ते जना ददृशुस्ततः। जातुषं तद् गृहं दग्धममात्यं च पुरोचनम्॥
en: Those men extinguished the fire and saw that the house was made of lac and that the counsellor Purochana had been burnt to death.

sa: ततस्तस्याज्ञया राज्ञो विप्रतस्थे महद् बलम् स तु राजा गिरिप्रस्थे तस्मिन् पुनरुपाविशत्॥
en: When that large number of attendants had gone away at the command of the king, the king again sat down on the mountain breast.

sa: तत्सर्वमपरं तात न संतत्या समं मतम्। स तात दृष्ट्वाबूयास्तं जरत्कारुं तपोधन॥
en: O child, they are inferior and cannot be equal to a son. O child, seeing all this, tell every thing to the Rishi Jaratkaru.

sa: संयुक्ता सा हि धर्मेण योगमूर्तिधरेण ह। लेभे पुत्रं वरारोहा सर्वप्राणभृतां हितम्॥
en: She was united with Dharma in his Yoga (spiritual) form and that beautiful lady obtained a son devoted to the good of all creatures.

sa: ततो वैकर्तनः कर्णः कर्मणा तेन सोऽभवत्। आमुक्तकवचो वीरो यस्तु जज्ञे महायशाः॥
en: But for his mighty deeds, he was subsequently called Karna. Because the greatly illustrious hero removed his natural coat of Arms (from his breast).

sa: अर्जुन उवाच तापत्य इति यद् वाक्यमुक्तवानसि मामिह। तदहं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तापत्यार्थं विनिश्चितम्॥
en: Arjuna said : You have addressed me as the descendant of Tapati. I wish to know what the precise signification of this word is.

sa: ततस्ते पणितं कृत्वा भगिन्यौ द्विजसत्तम। जग्मतुः परया प्रीत्या परं पारं महोदधेः॥
en: And having laid the wager, o best of Brahmanas, the two sisters proceeded in great delight to the other side of the great ocean.

sa: तस्य त्वं ब्रूहि सौमित्रे प्रजापालः स राघवः। अनाज्ञप्तस्तु सौमित्रे प्रवेष्टुं नेच्छयाम्यहम्॥
en: O Saumitri, do you go and communicate to the king protecting his subjects that without his permission I do not wish to go there."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते पाण्डवाः सर्वे पाञ्चाल्यश्च महायशाः। प्रत्युत्थाय महात्मानं कृष्णं सर्वेऽभ्यवादयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon all the Pandavas and the illustrious Panchala king and all others stood up; and they saluted the illustrious Krishna (Dvaipayana).

sa: अभिषेक्ष्यति मां राज्ये स पाञ्चालो यदा तदा। त्वद्भोग्यं भविता तात सखे सत्येन ते शपे॥ अलभद् गौतमी मम भोगाश्च वित्तं च त्वदधीनं सुखानि च। एवमुक्त्वाथ वव्राज कृतास्त्रः पूजितो मया॥
en: When my father (the king) would install me as the ruler of the Panchalas, it (the kingdom) shall be then enjoyed by you. O friend, this is my solemn promise. My kingdom, my wealth, my happiness all will be at your disposal.” When his study of the science of arms was finished he went away after being duly worshipped by me.

sa: सौतिरुवाच प्रतिश्रुते तु नागेन भरिष्ये भगिनीमिति। जरत्कारुस्तदा वेश्म भुजगस्य जगाम ह॥
en: Sauti said: When a promise was given by the snake that he would maintain his sister, Jaratkaru went to the house of the snake.

sa: शौनक उवाच आख्याता भुजगास्तात वीर्यवन्तो दुरासदाः। शापं तं तेऽभिविज्ञाय कृतवन्तः किमुत्तरम्॥
en: Shaunaka said: O child, you have told us of many greatly powerful and unconquerable serpents. What did they do after hearing of the curse?

sa: आश्वासयामास च तं कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। प्रतिजज्ञे च राज्याय दुपदो वदतां वरः॥
en: The foremost of all eloquent men, Drupada, gave every assurance to the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira and vowed to restore him to his kingdom.

sa: स तदन्नमुपादाय गतो बकवनं प्रति। तेन नूनं भवेदेतत् कर्म लोकहितं कृतम्॥
en: And taking the food, set out for the forest where Baka lived. This deed, so beneficial to us, must have been done by him.

sa: उवाच तं सत्यधृतिः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अभिजानामि सौम्य त्वां सुहृदं विदुरस्य वै॥ शुचिमाप्तं प्रियं चैव सदा च दृढभक्तिकम्। न विद्यते कवेः किंचिदविज्ञातं प्रयोजनम्॥
en: Yudhisthira said : Yudhisthira, the truthful son of Kunti, thus spoke to him. O amiable one, I now know you as a dear and trusted friend of Vidura, true and ever devoted to him. There is no necessity (of ours) which that learned man (Vidura) does not know.

sa: न हि शक्नोति तं यन्तुं पुत्रं कोपसमन्वितम्। ततोऽहं प्रेषितस्तेन तव राजन्हितार्थिना॥
en: As he has been unable to pacify his angry son, therefore, O king, I have been sent by him to you for your good.

sa: एवं ब्रुवत्येव युधिष्ठिरे तु पाञ्चालराजस्य समीपतोऽन्यः। तत्राजगामाशु नरो द्वितीयो निवेदयिष्यनिह सिद्धमन्नम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : While Yudhishthira was saying all this, the king of Panchala, another messenger came in haste and said “The feast is ready."

sa: वैशंपायन उवाच अथ नारायणेनेन्द्रश्चकार सह संविदम्। अवतर्तुं महीं स्वर्गादंशतः सहितः सुरैः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon, Hari held a consultation with Indra regarding his incarnation on earth with all the celestials according to their respective parts.

sa: जितेन्द्रियश्च वसुधां प्राप्स्यतीति च मेऽब्रवीत्। विज्ञातमिति तत् सर्वं प्रत्युक्तो विदुरो मया॥
en: He told me "The man who is self controlled wins (the sovereignty) of the whole world." I replied to Vidura. “I have understood you."

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवमस्त्विति तं वह्निः प्रत्युवाच पितामहम्। जगाम शासनं कर्तुं देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः॥
en: Sauti said: Agni then replied to the Grandfather, "Be it so" and he went away to obey the command of the Parameshthi (Supreme Lord).

sa: दृष्ट्वा सृष्टं तु नीहारं ततस्तं परमर्षिणा। विस्मिता साभवत्कन्या वीडिता च तपस्विनी॥
en: Seeing the sudden creation of the fog by the great Rishi, the girl was very much astonished and became suffused with blushes of bashfulness.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सुन्दोपसुन्दावसुरौ कस्य पुत्रौ महामुने। उत्पन्नश्च कथं भेदः कथं चान्योन्यमनताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O great Rishi, whose sons were Sunda and Upasunda? How did their dissension arise and why did they kill each other?

sa: असंशयं ध्यानपरो यथा वत्स तथा शृणु। अपत्यं नस्त्वमेवैकः कुले महति भारत॥
en: "Truly I am melancholy. Hear why I am so. O descendant of Bharata race, you are the only son in this our great dynasty.

sa: माल्यदामपरिक्षिप्ता विधिवक्रियतेऽपि च। भगवान्पूज्यते चाऽत्र हंसरूपेण चेश्वरः॥ स्वयमेव गृहीतेन वसोः प्रीत्या महात्मनः। स तां पूजा महेन्द्रस्तु दृष्ट्वा देवःकृतां शुभाम्॥ वसुना राजमुख्येन प्रीतिमानब्रवीत्प्रभुः। ये पूजयिष्यन्ति नरा राजानश्च महं मम॥
en: The god Indra was thus worshipped in due form with garlands and ornaments. The god, assuming the form of a swan, came himself to accept the worship thus offered. The great Indra was much pleased to see the auspicious worship thus made by Vasu, the best of kings and said to him, “ Those men and kings who will worship me,

sa: सौतिरुवाच स चिन्तयामास तदा मायायोगेन पार्थिवः। मया वञ्चयितव्योऽसौ क उपायो भवेदिति॥
en: Thereupon the snake reflected, saying. “The king must be deceived by me by my Maya (power of delusion). But what must be the means?"

sa: विजेता नाभवत् कश्चित् कृष्णपाण्डवयोर्मधे। तयोर्बलात् परित्रातुं तं च दावं यदा सुराः॥
en: When the celestial found that they could not extinguish the fire or protect the forest from the prowess (of Arjuna and Krishna), they retired.

sa: अतीतानागता भावा ये च वर्तन्ति साम्प्रतम्। तान्कालनिर्मितान् बुद्ध्वा न संज्ञां हातुमर्हसि॥
en: Knowing that all things, past, present and future, are the outcome of Time it is not fit for you to be overcome with grief.

sa: ततः सर्वे तथेत्युक्त्वा सह मात्रा महारथाः। प्रययुः पुरुषव्याघ्रा हिडिम्बा चैव राक्षसी॥
en: Those best of men (the Pandavas), those great car warriors, saying “Be it so," proceeded with their mother. And Rakshasi Hidimba also (followed them.)

sa: न तद् ध्यायति कौन्तेयः पाण्डुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। यथैषां पुरुषव्याघ्रः श्रेयो ध्यायति केशवः॥
en: The son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, himself does not seek the welfare of the Pandavas so much as this foremost of men Keshava (Krishna) does.

sa: योगेन बहुधात्मानं कृत्वा तिष्ठामि मूर्तिषु। अग्निहोत्रेषु सत्रेषु क्रियासु च मखेषु च॥
en: Having multiplied myself by Yoga power, I am present in many forms. (I am present) in the Agnihotra, Satras, rituals and in other sacrifices.

sa: यत्र यत्र च दृश्यन्ते प्राणिनः खाण्डवालयाः। पलायन्तः प्रवीरौ तौ तत्र तत्राभ्यधावताम्॥
en: Wherever and whenever they saw any creature, any dweller of the Khandava, escaping from the fire, those two great heroes immediately shot it down.

sa: पावकश्च तदा दावं दग्ध्वा समृगपक्षिणम्। अहानि पञ्च चैकं च विरराम सुतर्पितः॥
en: Agni also, having burnt that forest with all its creatures, animals and birds (continually) for fifteen days, became gratified; and he then extinguished himself.

sa: वर्गोवाच ततो वयं प्रव्यथिताः सर्वा भारतसत्तम। अयाम शरणं विप्रं तं तपोधनमच्युतम्॥
en: Varga said : O best of the Bharata race, we were all greatly distressed. We sought the protection of that ascetic of undeviating vows.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ता तदा गङ्गा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्। भर्तारं जाह्नवी देवी शान्तनुं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, the celestial lady, the daughter of Jahnu, Ganga, replied to her husband, the best of men, Shantanu.

sa: काश्यप उवाच अहं तं नृपतिं गत्वा त्वया दष्टमपज्वरम्। करिष्यामीति मे बुद्धिर्विद्याबलसमन्विता॥
en: Kashyapa said : I am possessed with the power of learning. Going there, I am sure I shall cure the king bitten by you.

sa: श्राद्धावसाने तु तदा दृष्ट्वा तं दुःखितं जनम्। सम्मूढां दुःखशोका” व्यासो मातरमब्रवीत्॥
en: After the completion of the Shraddha Vyasa, seeing all the people plunged in grief, spoke to his bereaved and greatly afflicted mother (Satyavati) thus,

sa: तानि सर्वाणि तीर्थानि ततः प्रभृति चैव ह। नारीतीर्थानि नाम्नेह ख्याति यास्यन्ति सर्वशः। पुण्यानि च भविष्यन्ति पावनानि मनीषिणाम्॥
en: From that day all those sacred Tirthas will be known by the name of Nari Tirthas all over the world. All of them will be sacred and sincleansing in the eyes of the virtuous and the wise.

sa: अथ मासे तु संपूर्णे पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः। प्रजापतिसुतः श्रीमाञ्शयने प्रत्यबुध्यत॥ सोऽपश्यत्सोमजं तत्र तपन्तं सलिलाशये। ऊर्ध्वबाहुं निरालम्बं तं राजा प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: There upon after the expiry of a month, the graceful king Ila, son of Soma, engaged from sleep and beholding Budha, the son of Soma, engaged in austerities with uplifted hands in the midst of waters, said.

sa: विदुराय च वै पाण्डुः प्रेषयामास तद् धनम्। सुहृदश्चापि धर्मात्मा धनेन समतर्पयत्॥
en: Pandu sent a portion of the wealth to Vidura. The virtuous minded man (Pandu) gratified his friends and relatives with (the presents of) wealth.

sa: तेषां जनयिता नान्यस्त्वदृते भुवि विद्यते। मद्विधा मानुषी धात्री लोके नास्तीह काचन॥
en: There is none on earth who desires to be their progenitor. There is none among human females like me who may be their mother.

sa: न कार्यं यदि सोमेन मम सोमः प्रदीयताम्। अस्मांस्ते हि प्रबाधेयुर्येभ्यो दद्याद्भवानिमम्॥
en: If you do not require the Soma, kindly return it to me. Those to whom you will give it will always quarrel with us.

sa: स ते तात न हन्तव्यः संक्रुद्धेनापि सर्वथा॥ ब्राह्मणानामभिद्रोहो न कर्तव्यः कथंचन।
en: O child, he is never to be killed by you even if you be angry. Enmity with Brahmanas is never proper under any circumstances.

sa: गरुड उवाच किंचित्कारणमुद्दिश्य सोमोऽयं नीयते मया। न दास्यामि समादातुं सोमं कस्मैचिदप्यहम्॥
en: Garuda said: There is a reason why I am taking away the Soma. I shall not give the Soma to any body to drink.

sa: आदिप्रभृति गेयं स्यान्न चावज्ञाय पार्थिवम्। पिता हि सर्वभूतानां राजा भवति धर्मतः॥
en: Before you begin with the song, without disregarding the king, do you bow to him reverentially. Morally the king is the father of all.

sa: स चचार सहामात्यो मृगयां गहने वने। मृगान् विध्यन् वराहांश्च रम्येषु मरुधन्वसु॥
en: He wandered with his ministers in the deep forest for the purpose of hunting Killing deer and boars, he roamed through the charming marshes.

sa: रामस्य च सुता ये स्युस्तेषामायुः कियद्भवेत्। काम्यया भगवन्ब्रूहि वंशस्यास्य गतिं मम॥
en: How long shall the descendants of Rāma live? And what shall be the end of my race? Do you relate all this to me.

sa: शब्दस्पर्शी तथा रूपं रसो गन्धश्च भारत। प्रकृतिश्च विकारच यच्चान्यत् कारणं भुवः॥
en: Sound, Touch, Form, Taste, Scent, Nature, the Modes, the Elemental and Prime causes of the world, O descendant of Bharata, (all these sit there).

sa: शापाभिहतचेतास्तु स्वात्मना भावितोऽभवत्॥ अर्चयामास तं देवं भृगुः शापेन पीडितः। तपसाराधितो देवो ह्यब्रवीद्भक्तवत्सलः॥ लोकानां संप्रियार्थ तं शापं मृह्यमुक्तवान्।
en: Having imprecated this curse, Bhțgu was greatly pained and being propitiated by his adoration, Visnu, fond of disciples, said. “Having slain Rāvaņa and others, I shall be, for the behoof of . mankind, subject to this imprecation."

sa: न च स्म किंचिच्छक्नोति भूतं निश्चरितुं ततः। संछाद्यमाने खे बाणैरस्यता सव्यसाचिना॥
en: When the sky over the forest was thus covered with the arrows of Savyasachi (Arjuna), not a single creature could escape (from that forest).

sa: तत्फलं प्राप्स्यते चापि भृगुशापकृतं महत्। अयोध्यायाः पती रामो दीर्घकालं भविष्यति ॥
en: O conferer of honours, for sooth shall Rāma partake of the fruits of Bhrgu's curse. He shall reign in Ayodhyā for a long time.

sa: स कदाचिद्वनं गत्वा विप्रः पितृवचः स्मरन्। चुक्रोश कन्याभिक्षार्थी तिस्रो वाचः शनैरिव॥
en: One day he went into the forest and remembering the words of his ancestors, he thrice begged for a bride in a faint voice.

sa: तव पुत्रा दुरात्मानः प्रतप्ताश्चैव मन्युना। लुब्धा दुर्वृत्तभूयिष्ठा न ताञ्छोचितुमर्हसि॥ श्रुतवानसि मेधावी बुद्धिमान्प्राज्ञसंमतः। येषां शास्त्रानुगाबुद्धिर्न ते मुह्यन्ति भारत॥
en: Your wicked, envious, avaricious, of passionate temperament and vicious disposition; you are well-versed in the Shastras, you are intelligent and wise; those men whose understanding follows the dictates of the Shastras, never succumb to grief or misfortune.

sa: दृश्यते न च कार्यार्थी रामे राज्यं प्रशासति। लक्ष्मणः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा रामायैवं न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Thus during the administration of Rāma none was seen who wanted justice. Laksmana, with folded hands, said to Rāma, “None has come for business."

sa: क्षात्रेण च बलेनास्य नापश्यत् स पराजयम्। हीनं विदित्वा चात्मानं ब्राह्मण स बलेन तु॥ पुत्रजन्म परीप्सन् वै पृथिवीमन्वसंचरत्। अहिच्छत्रं च विषयं द्रोणः समभिपद्यत॥
en: He was well convinced that his could not defeat Drona by Kshatriya might alone, he being very much inferior to him in Brahma (spiritual) power. He therefore wandered over the world to find the rneans of obtaining a son (who could defeat Drona). (Meanwhile) Drona lived at Ahichatra.

sa: पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तः प्रज्ञाचक्षुर्नराधिपः। कृष्णोपनीतां यत्रासावायसी प्रतिमां दृढाम्॥ भीमसेनद्रोहबुद्धिधृतराष्ट्रो बभञ्ज ह। तथा शोकाभितप्तस्य धृतराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः॥ संसारगहनं बुद्ध्या हेतुभिर्मोक्षदर्शनैः। विदुरेण च यत्रास्य राज्ञ आश्वासनं कृतम्॥
en: Then greatly wise Dhritarashtra, being much afflicted by the death of his sons, moved with vengeance, crushed into pieces an iron statute, the substitute for Bhima, placed before him by Krishna. Then Vidura consoled the great king by removing his worldly affections with reasons pointing to final emancipation.

sa: यथैव पाण्डोः पुत्रास्तु तथैवाभ्यधिका मम। यथा चाभ्यधिका बुद्धिर्मम तान् प्रति तच्छृणु॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: Those children are dearer to me then they were to Pandu, know that my affection for them is now greater then before.

sa: हनुरेका स्थिता त्वस्य भूमावेका दिवं गता। चतस्रश्चायता दंष्ट्रा योजनानां शतं शतम्॥
en: One of his jaws rested on earth and the other stretched to heaven. He had four fangs extending as far as one hundred yojanas.

sa: वल्मीकमात्रः सप्ताहं यद्यनेन धृतोऽचलः। तदा गोवर्धनो भीष्म न तच्चित्रं मतं मम॥
en: O Bhishma, in my opinion there was nothing remarkable in this one's holding for a week the Govardhana hill which is like an anthill.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच न पुरा भीमसेन त्वमीदृशीर्वदिता गिरः। परैस्ते नाशितं नूनं नृशंसैर्धर्मगौरवम्॥
en: Arjuna said O Bhimasena, you have never before uttered such swords as these. Your high morality has certainly been destroyed by these cruel foes.

sa: न हि कश्चित् क्षमाकालो विद्यतेऽद्य कुरून् प्रति। तेजसश्चागते काले तेज उत्स्रष्टुमर्हसि॥
en: This is not the time for showing forgiveness towards the Kurus; when the hour for showing might arrives, it behoves you to display it.

sa: तद् वै पिपीलिकं नाम उद्धृतं यत् पिपीलिकैः। जातरूपं द्रोणमेयमहायुः पुञ्जशो नृपाः॥
en: Brought as tribute heaps of gold measured in Dronas (jars) and raised from underneath the earth by ants, and therefore called after the ants.

sa: गुरवः सर्वे वृद्धा वैद्याश्च पूजिताः। कच्चिन्न कुरुषे भावं पार्थ पापेषु कर्मसु॥
en: Are all your superiors and elders and those versed in the Vedas honoured by you? Do you not incline your mind towards sinful acts?

sa: एवं साशोकवृक्षं तमार्ता वै परिगम्य ह। जगाम दारुणतरं देशं भैमी वराङ्गना॥
en: That excellent of damsels the afflicted daughter of Bhima, then three-times going round the Ashoka tree, entered a more dreary part of the wilderness.

sa: त्रिदिवे यस्य सदृशो नास्ति रूपेण कश्चन। अतुलत्वात् कृतो देवैर्नाम्ना कामस्तु पावकः॥
en: He had a son like whom there was none in heaven in personal beauty. And therefore he was called by the celestials “Kama Agni”.

sa: बहुनापि ह्यविद्वांसो नैव तुष्यन्त्यबुद्धयः। तेषां नधर्मजं किंचित् प्रेत्य शर्मास्ति वा पुनः॥
en: Ignorant and stupid persons are not satisfied even with much and they have no happiness begotten of virtue for them in the next world.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इत्युक्तवान्तर्हितस्तात स देवः परमाद्भुतः। प्रजाश्चेमाः प्रपश्यामि विचित्रा विविधाः कृताः॥
en: Markandeya said : O child, having said this that greatly wonderful deity disappeared. I then saw this varied and wonderful creation start into life.

sa: न व्याधयो नापि यमः प्राप्तुं श्रेयः प्रतीक्षते। यावदेव भवेत् कल्पस्तावच्छ्रेयः समाचरेत्॥
en: Neither disease nor Yama (Death) waits till one is in prosperity. Therefore, so long there is life and breath, let us accomplish this purpose.

sa: तेषु सर्वेषु कौरव्य प्रतियातेषु पाण्डवाः। तस्मिन्नेव वने हृष्टास्त अषुः सह कृष्णया।॥
en: O descendant of the Kurus, when all those had taken their departure, the Pandavas, together with Krishna, began to dwell cheerfully in that forest.

sa: सा वै यथा त्वया दृष्टा तथाऽऽस्ते त्वत्प्रतीक्षिणा दह्यमाना भृशं वाला वस्त्रार्थेनाभिसंवृता॥
en: 'Indeed, in obedience to your command that lady, covered in half a piece of cloth and greatly burning with woe, is ever expecting you.

sa: ये त्वन्ये पृथिवीपालाः समेताः सर्वतो दिशः। कामक्रोधौ समुत्सृज्य ते ब्रुवन्तु यथामति॥
en: Let the kings that have assembled here from all directions, leaving aside all motives of anger and desire, speak our according to their judgement.

sa: ते मयाऽऽश्वासिता वीरा यथावद् भरतर्षभ। सर्वे मामब्रुवन् हृष्टाः प्रयाहि जहि शात्रवान्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, thus adequately encouraged by me, they all with cheerful hearts said to me, “Go and kill the enemy."

sa: सहदेवश्च मे पुत्रः सदावेक्ष्योः वने वसन्। यथेदं व्यसनं प्राप्य नायं सीदेमहामतिः॥
en: While living in the woods, keep your eyes always on my child Sahadeva, so that his mind may not sink under this great calamity.

sa: न भीमसेने कोपो मे प्रीतोऽस्मि भरतरर्षभ। कर्मणः भीमसेनस्य मम तुष्टिरभूत् पुरा॥
en: O the most exalted of the Bharatas, I am rather pleased than angry with Bhimasena-nay this act of Bhimasena has made me supremely happy.

sa: न ह्येतत् संयुगे कर्तुमपि शक्तः सुरेश्वरः। सुरासुरैरवध्यं हि पुरमेतत् खगं महत्॥
en: Even the lord of the gods cannot perform such a fcat in battle. This great aerial city, indestructible by the gods and the Asuras,

sa: एतैर्हि राजा नियतं चोद्यमानः शमं प्रति। राज्यं दातेति मे बुद्धिर्न चेल्लोभान्नशिष्यति॥
en: Being led by all these towards peace the king will return us the kingdom; if he yields to temptation he will meet with destruction.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ब्राह्मणं क्रोधसंतप्तं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा। दृष्ट्वा साध्वी मनुष्येन्द्र सान्त्वपूर्वं वचोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Markandeya said : O foremost of individuals, seeing that Brahmana greatly enraged and effulgent in energy, the chaste lady addressed him in friendly expressions.

sa: तेन तत् संवृतं दृष्ट्वा ते राजपरिचारकाः। प्रतिजग्मुस्ततो राजन् यत्र दुर्योधनो नृपः॥
en: O king, finding the lake closed by the Gandharva king, the royal attendants (of Duryodhana) went back to the place where their king was.

sa: महेश्वरेण यो राजन् न जीर्णो ह्यष्टमूर्तिना। कस्तमुत्सहते वीरो युद्धे जरयितुं पुमान्॥
en: O king, who is there who will be able to weaken that hero who was not weakened by Maheswara (Shiva) himself with eight forms?

sa: मृदुना दारुणं हन्ति मृदुना हन्त्यदारुणम्। नासाध्यं मृदुना किंचित् तस्मात् तीव्रतरं मृदु॥
en: Strength might be vanquished by forgiveness, weakness might be vanquished by forgiveness; there is nothing which forgiveness cannot accomplish, therefore forgiveness is truly fiercer.

sa: इमौ च सिंहसंकाशौ भ्रातरौ सहितौ शिशू॥ नकुलः सहदेवश्च कथं पार्थ चरिष्यतः।
en: How will these lion-like young children, together with the two brothers. Nakula and Sahadeva, O son of Pritha, be able to live in secrecy?

sa: तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशश्च ततः परम्। तथा वर्षसहहरे द्वे द्वापरं परिमाणतः॥
en: Its morning and evening comprise three hundred years. The Yuga that follows is called Dvapara and it is said to comprise two thousand years.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच यदा स्कन्देन मातृणामेवमेतत् प्रियं कृतम्। अथैनमब्रवीत् स्वाहा मम पुत्रस्त्वमौरसः॥
en: Markandeya said : When Skanda had done all these favourite works of the mothers, Svaha appeared before him and said, “You are my son.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच आनर्तनगरं मुक्तं ततोऽहमगमं तदा। महाक्रतौ राजसूये निवृत्ते नृपते तव॥
en: Krishna said: O king, when he (Shalva) left the city of the Anarthas, I returned there on the completion of your great Rajasuya sacrifice.

sa: अवलिप्तस्य मूर्खस्य केशवं स्तोतुमिच्छतः। कथं भीष्म न ते जिह्वा शतधेयं विदीर्यते॥
en: O Bhishma, arrogant and fool as you are, and also desirous of praising Krishna, why does not your tongue split into a hundred parts?

sa: स तु नूनं महाबाहुः प्रियार्थं मम पाण्डवः। प्रागुदीची दिशं राजंस्तान्याहर्तुमितो गतः॥
en: Has perhaps, O king, gone towards the north-east to get them.” Having been thus addressed by her, the king thus spoke to the twins,

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। युगसंख्यां महाबाहो स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि गम्यताम्॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, I have thus told you all that you asked me about the different Yugas. May good come to you. Now return.

sa: कोटितीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा अर्चयित्वा गुहं नृप। गोसहस्रफलं विद्यात् तेजस्वी च भवेन्नरः॥
en: O king, bathing in the Koti Tirtha and worshipping Guha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and becomes effulgent.

sa: दह्यमाना हि राजानः पाण्डवोत्थेन वह्निना। क्षान्तवन्तोऽपराधं ते को हि तत् क्षन्तुमर्हति॥
en: The kings appeared (as if) they were consumed by the Pandava fire; therefore they were forgiving, for else who could pardon such an offence?

sa: तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं तं मुनि नियतव्रतम्। तस्थुः सर्वे स तु मुनिस्तेषां पूजामथाहरत्॥
en: And bowing down to that high-souled sage constantly engaged in austerities they remained standing there and the Muni 10O busied himself to welcome them.

sa: ततः प्रसन्ना पृथिवी तपसा तस्य पाण्डव। पुनरुनह्य सलिलाद् वेदीरूपा स्थिता बभौ॥
en: O son of Pandu, thereupon the earth was gratified with his asceticism. She again rose from the water and remained as a sacrificial altar.

sa: यावदस्थि मनुष्यस्य गङ्गाया स्पृशते जलम्। तावत् स पुरुषो राजन् स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: O king, so long a man's bones lie in the waters of the Ganges, so long that man is adored in the celestials region,

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच सत्त्वस्य रजसश्चैव तमसश्च यथातथम्। गुणांस्तत्त्वेन मे ब्रूहि यथावदिह पृच्छतः॥
en: The Brahmana said: Truly describe to me who duly now ask you tne respective virtues of the three qualities, namely Sattva, Raja and Tama.

sa: दाक्ष्यं घमर्ष: शौर्यं च शीघ्रत्वमिति तेजसः। गुणाः क्रोधाभिभूतेन न शक्याः प्राप्तुमञ्जसा॥
en: The man that is possessed by anger does not easily acquire generosity, dignity, bravery, skill and other accomplishments of a real man of character.

sa: न तथा तपसा राजैल्लोकान् प्राप्नोति क्षत्रियः। यथा सृष्टेन युद्धेन विजयेनेतरेण वा॥
en: O king, a Kshatriya cannot acquire those regions of blessedness which he can by fair fight, whether (that fight) ends in victory or defeat.

sa: कार्तिकी तु विशेषेण योऽभिगच्छति पुष्करम्॥ प्राप्नुयात् स नरो लोकान् ब्रह्मणः सदनेऽक्षयान्।
en: Especially he who goes to Pushkara in the full-moon on the (month) of Kartikeya, that man, obtains everlasting regions in the abode of Brahma.

sa: इतः प्रद्रवतां रात्रौ यः स तेषां महात्मनाम्॥ आवृत्य मार्ग रौद्रात्मा तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः। तं भीमः समरश्लाघी बलेन बलिनां वरः॥ जघान पशुमारेण व्याघ्रः क्षुद्रमृगं यथा। पश्य दिग्विजये राजन् यथा भीमेन पातितः॥ जरासंधो महेष्वासो नागायुतबलो युधि। सम्बन्धी वासुदेवश्च श्याला: सर्वे च पार्षताः॥
en: When departing from this place, he (Kirmira) of fearful soul obstructed in the night the path of those high-souled ones like an immovable hill, that foremost of all strong men, Bhima, ever delighting in fight. Killed him like a beast, as a tiger kills a small deer. O king, see how Bhima, when out for conquest, killed. The great bow-man Jarasandha who possessed the strength of ten thousand elephants. Related (as they are) with Vasudeva (Krishna) and having sons of Prishata (Draupada) as their brother-in-law.

sa: निर्दहन् नागलोकं च यच्च किञ्चित् क्षिताविह। अधस्तात् पृथिवीपाल सर्वं नाशयते क्षणात्॥
en: O ruler of earth, burning down the nether region and also everything on this earth, that fire then destroys all things in a moment.

sa: न वाच्यो व्यवसायो मे विदुरैतद् ब्रवीमि ते। दैवमेव परं मन्ये येनैतदुपपद्यते॥
en: O Vidura, I tell you, this is my resolution. Do not tell me any thing. I regard Fate as supreme; she brings all this.

sa: असौ मतिमतां श्रेष्ठो य एथ जगतः प्रभुः। सम्भावयति चाप्येवं त्वद्वाक्याच्च जनार्दनः। एवमेतत् सर्वमिति तत् सर्वं वितथं ध्रुवम्॥
en: "This one is the foremost of all wise men," and "This one is the lord of the universe," hearing these words of yours, Janardana (Krishna) believes that they are all true. But they are surely all false.

sa: देवदेव उवाच नरसवं पूर्वदेहे वै नारायणसहायवान्। बदाँ तप्तवानुचं तपो वर्षायुतान् बहून्॥
en: Shiva said: You were in your former life Nara, the friend of Narayana, You passed many thousands of years in fearful and austere asceticism.

sa: अति यज्ञविदां लोकान् क्षमिणः प्राप्नुवन्ति च। अति ब्रह्मविदां लोकानति चापि तपस्विनाम्॥
en: Forgiving persons attain to the regions of those conversant with the rituals, of those wellversed with the knowledge of Brahman and those of ascetics.

sa: सुकृतं प्रतिकर्तुं च कच्चिद्धातुं च दुष्कृतम्। यथान्यायं कुरुश्रेष्ठ जानासि न विकत्यसे॥
en: Ó best of the Kurus, do you properly know how to perform praiseworthy acts and how to avoid wicked ones? Are you not selfconceited?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच नकुलस्य तु वक्ष्यामि कर्माणि विजयं तथा। वासुदेवजितामाशां यथासावजयत् प्रभुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said I shall now describe to you the conquests of Nakula and how that lord conquered the countries one subjugated by Vasudeva (Krishna).

sa: लोमश उवाच तं दृष्ट्वा घोरवदनं मदं देवः शतक्रतुः। आयान्तं भक्षयिष्यन्तं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Lomasha said: Having seen the fearful-faced Mada, coming with open mouth like death himself with the intention of devouring him, the deity Shatakratu (Indra).

sa: ततः पिपीलिका जन्तुं कदाचिददशत् स्फिचि। स दष्टो व्यनदन्नादं तेन दुःखेन बालकः॥
en: One day an ant stung the boy at his hip and the boy screamed out on account of the pain caused by the sting.

sa: प्रतर्दन इत्यब्रवीदृषिः। तत्र किं कारणं प्रतर्दनस्यापि गृहे मयोषितं स मां रथेनानुप्रावहत्॥
en: The Rishi said, "Pratardana." "What is its cause?" "I also lived in the house of Pratardana. One day he took me in his car.

sa: काले मृदुर्यो भवति काले भवति दारुणः। स वै सुखमवाप्नोति लोकेऽमुष्मिन्निहैव च॥
en: He, who is forgiving in proper hour and angry when the occasion arises, attains to happiness both in this world and in the next.

sa: उष्ट्वा द्वादश वर्षाणि पुष्करे नियतः शुचिः॥ क्रतून् सर्वानवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति।
en: He who lives at Pushkara for twelve years in purity. Acquires all the merits of performing sacrifices and goes to the region of Brahma.

sa: अप्येकं भोजयेद् विप्रं पुष्करारण्यमाश्रितः। तेनासौ कर्मणा भीष्म प्रेत्य चेह च मोदते॥
en: O Bhishma, he, who, going to the forest of Pushkara, feeds but only one Brahmana, becomes by his that act happy here and hereafter.
